name: Seller Sign In
description: The seller signs in with email and password to reach their private business records.

steps.description: Seller opens the login page and signs in through the Clerk sign-in form with their email and password.

business_rules.name: seller_must_sign_in_to_access_business_records
business_rules.description: Customers, invoices, payments, bills, forecasts and settings are available only after the seller signs in with a valid account (signed out → signed in).
triggers: Seller submits the login form with email and password
Seller opens any business page without an active signed-in session
side_effects: A signed-in session is created for the matching User, and the seller is taken to the Today page
Business pages stay locked and the seller is sent to the login page until sign-in succeeds
error_handling: Email is not registered or password does not match: show one generic 'email or password is incorrect' message without revealing which one was wrong
Too many failed attempts: temporarily block further attempts and show a message asking the seller to wait before trying again
Session has expired: return the seller to the login page and keep any unsaved draft text where possible

business_rules.name: seller_account_is_the_only_signin_identity_in_mvp
business_rules.description: The Clerk account is the only sign-in identity in the MVP; the app holds no local passwords.
triggers: seller submits sign-in form
error_handling: Sign-in is refused when no Clerk account matches

missing: User.clerk_user_id — no column clerk_user_id on users

business_rules.name: public_demo_access_is_isolated_from_private_records
business_rules.description: Signing in to a public judge demo gives access only to a separate fictional dataset, never to the seller's private records.
triggers: Seller or judge signs in through the demo sign-in path
Demo account credentials are used on the deployed link
side_effects: The session is bound to the demo workspace, so customers, invoices, expenses and shop details shown are fictional
Private seller records remain unreachable from the demo session
error_handling: Demo account requested while demo is disabled: show a message that the demo is unavailable and offer the normal sign-in form

business_rules.name: session_persists_per_clerk_expiry_and_revocation
business_rules.description: A signed-in seller stays signed in across refresh and restart only until Clerk's configured session expiry or a revocation (sign-out or password change) ends the session; the app never promises indefinite sign-in.
triggers: Page refresh
App restart
Session expiry or revocation
side_effects: An expired or revoked session requires signing in again; business records are untouched
error_handling: An expired session sends the seller to /login with a message to sign in again

business_rules.name: seller_profile_linked_by_clerk_user_id
business_rules.description: After Clerk sign-in, the seller's User record is found by matching User.clerk_user_id to the Clerk user ID; without a match no business records are shown.
triggers: seller completes Clerk sign-in
side_effects: Seller's business records load for the matched profile
error_handling: No matching profile: seller is told the account is not set up and sees no records

missing: User.clerk_user_id — no column clerk_user_id on users

validation_rules.description: Email is required to sign in.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your email address.

validation_rules.description: Email must be a valid email address format (for example name@example.com).
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.

steps.description: Seller is taken to the Today page, which shows follow-ups, bills and cash alerts.

business_rules.name: alerts_are_derived_from_linked_records
business_rules.description: Alerts exist only for overdue invoices, upcoming supplier bills, projected cash shortages, and overdue invoices without an expected collection date, and each alert points to the record that caused it.
triggers: Seller signs in and the Today page loads
An invoice, payment, bill, or forecast result changes
The daily date rolls over in Asia/Kolkata time
side_effects: Alert records of type overdue_invoice, upcoming_bill, cash_shortage, or missing_expected_date are created as active
Each alert stores the invoice, bill, or forecast it refers to so the Today page can link to it
Alerts shown on Today are ordered by severity, then by outstanding amount and days overdue
error_handling: If the linked invoice or bill no longer exists, the alert is marked resolved rather than shown with a broken link
If an alert type cannot be determined from the source record, no alert is created and the issue is logged for review

business_rules.name: alerts_resolve_or_update_when_records_change
business_rules.description: An alert resolves or updates automatically when its underlying record changes, such as an invoice reaching zero outstanding balance or a bill being marked paid.
triggers: A payment is recorded against an invoice
An invoice is cancelled or moved to draft
An expected collection date is set on an overdue invoice
A bill is marked paid or its due date is edited
A forecast is recalculated after a record change
side_effects: An overdue_invoice alert resolves when the invoice outstanding balance becomes zero
A missing_expected_date alert resolves when the seller sets an expected collection date
An upcoming_bill alert resolves when Expense.paid_at is set
A cash_shortage alert updates its amount and date to match the recalculated forecast or resolves if the shortage disappears
error_handling: If a recalculation fails, the existing alert is kept unchanged and marked as needing recheck rather than being silently removed
A payment that would overpay an invoice is rejected before any alert is updated

business_rules.name: overdue_unpaid_bills_flagged_as_outflows_today
business_rules.description: Overdue unpaid bills are flagged for immediate attention and treated as cash outflows today until the seller explicitly sets a revised expected payment date.
triggers: An unpaid expense passes its due date in Asia/Kolkata time
The Today page loads and checks upcoming bills
The seller edits or clears the revised payment date on a bill
side_effects: An upcoming_bill alert is shown at the top of the Today page as needing immediate attention
The forecast counts the overdue bill as an outflow today, and the Today page states this assumption
Once the seller sets Expense.revised_payment_date, the bill is dated on that day in the forecast and the alert reflects it
error_handling: If Expense.amount is missing or zero, the bill is still flagged overdue but the Today page shows it as amount needed instead of a rupee figure
Setting a revised date in the past is rejected with a message asking for today or a later date

business_rules.name: today_page_separates_followups_bills_and_cash_alerts
business_rules.description: The Today page groups active alerts into three sections: follow-ups for overdue invoices, bills coming up, and cash alerts, with empty states for each when nothing is active.
triggers: Seller signs in and is redirected to the Today page
The seller returns to the Today page from another screen
side_effects: Overdue invoices appear in the follow-ups section with their customer, outstanding balance, and days overdue
Each follow-up entry shows the most recent FollowUp.sent_at for that invoice
Bills due within the coming period appear in the bills section with their category and due date
Projected shortages appear in the cash alerts section with a link to review affected collections and bills
error_handling: If no alerts are active, each section shows an empty state with a short explanation instead of a blank area
If loading the alerts fails, the page shows an error state with a retry option and does not show stale counts as current

missing: FollowUp.sent_at — no table for FollowUp
FollowUp.invoice_id — no table for FollowUp

business_rules.name: alerts_never_contact_customers_or_move_dates
business_rules.description: Alerts only inform the seller; they never send messages to customers, mark a follow-up as sent, or change any payment or expected collection date automatically.
triggers: An alert is created or updated
The seller views or dismisses an alert on the Today page
side_effects: No reminder is sent to any customer by the system
FollowUp.sent_at is set only when the seller explicitly records a sent follow-up
Invoice.expected_collection_date and Expense.revised_payment_date are changed only by the seller's own edits
Dismissing an alert records Alert.status as dismissed without changing the underlying record
error_handling: If an automated process attempts to change a payment date, the change is blocked and logged as an error
If the seller dismisses an alert whose condition still holds, the alert stays dismissed but reappears if the condition persists after the next recalculation

missing: FollowUp.sent_at — no table for FollowUp

business_rules.name: draft_cancelled_and_paid_records_excluded_from_alerts
business_rules.description: Draft and cancelled invoices and paid invoices or bills never generate alerts or count toward receivables or upcoming outflows.
triggers: An invoice is saved as draft or cancelled
An invoice or bill becomes fully paid
The Today page loads its alert list
side_effects: Existing alerts for an invoice moved to draft or cancelled are resolved
Existing alerts for a fully paid invoice or bill are resolved
Draft and cancelled invoices are absent from the follow-ups section
error_handling: If an invoice status is unrecognised, it is excluded from alerts and flagged for review rather than included by default
Cancelling an invoice that has recorded payments is blocked with a message asking the seller to review those payments first

business_rules.name: alert_dates_use_asia_kolkata_calendar
business_rules.description: Overdue status, days overdue, and upcoming-bill windows on the Today page are calculated using the Asia/Kolkata calendar date.
triggers: Today page loads
Midnight passes in Asia/Kolkata time while the page is open
An alert's day count is recalculated
side_effects: Days overdue on follow-up entries increments at Asia/Kolkata midnight
Bills move into the due-soon or overdue state based on the Asia/Kolkata date
error_handling: If the browser time zone differs from Asia/Kolkata, the app still uses Asia/Kolkata for all overdue and due-date calculations
If the date cannot be determined, the Today page shows an error state instead of guessing an overdue status

business_rules.name: seller_profile_created_if_missing
business_rules.description: After Clerk verifies the seller, the server creates the local seller profile for that clerk_user_id only if none exists, then links the session to it.
triggers: Clerk verifies a sign-in
Today page is requested by a signed-in seller
side_effects: One local seller profile is created the first time a verified Clerk user arrives
error_handling: If the profile cannot be created, the seller sees a retryable setup error on Today instead of an empty dashboard

business_rules.name: seller_profile_creation_is_repeat_safe
business_rules.description: Repeated or concurrent requests for the same clerk_user_id never create a second seller profile; clerk_user_id is a unique key on User.
triggers: Repeated page loads
Concurrent requests from the same sign-in
side_effects: The existing profile is reused with its records intact
error_handling: A duplicate attempt reuses the existing profile and shows no error

business_rules.name: seller_profile_setup_error_is_retryable
business_rules.description: If profile setup fails, Today shows a setup error with a retry action that repeats the same safe creation step.
triggers: Profile creation fails on Today
side_effects: The failed attempt creates or changes no business records
error_handling: Retry repeats the safe creation; if it keeps failing, the seller stays on the setup error with a message

name: Seller Account Sign Up
description: A new seller creates an account to keep their private business records.

steps.description: Visitor opens the sign-up page and creates an account through Clerk, entering name and email; Clerk collects and stores the password.

business_rules.name: signup_creates_private_seller_account
business_rules.description: Sign-up creates the account in Clerk and a linked private seller profile whose User.clerk_user_id matches it.
triggers: seller submits sign-up form
side_effects: A private seller profile is created and linked to the Clerk account
error_handling: If the profile cannot be created, the seller is not signed in to the app and is told to try again

missing: User.clerk_user_id — no column clerk_user_id on users

business_rules.name: signup_email_is_unique_per_user
business_rules.description: Each User.email is stored in lowercase and can belong to only one User account, so one email cannot open two seller accounts.
triggers: Visitor submits sign-up with an email
Visitor submits sign-up with an email differing only in letter case from an existing account
side_effects: The entered email is saved in lowercase
The existing account is not changed
error_handling: Duplicate email (case-insensitive) is rejected with a message that the email is already registered
Email is never accepted as a duplicate of the public demo account, which uses fictional data and its own sign-in

business_rules.name: signup_password_held_only_by_clerk
business_rules.description: Clerk sets and stores the password; the app stores no password or password hash for any seller.
triggers: seller submits sign-up form
error_handling: Password rules and errors are shown by Clerk

validation_rules.description: Name is required and must not be blank after trimming spaces.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter your name.

validation_rules.description: Name is at most 100 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Name must be 100 characters or fewer.

validation_rules.description: Email is required and is used as the sign-in identifier.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter your email address.

validation_rules.description: Email must be a valid address with one @ sign, a domain, and a dot in the domain.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.

validation_rules.description: Email must not already belong to another User account (compared case-insensitively).
validation_rules.error_message: This email is already registered. Try signing in instead.

steps.description: Seller is signed in and sent to the Today page, which is empty until records are added.

business_rules.name: seller_lands_on_today_after_sign_in
business_rules.description: After a seller signs in, they are taken straight to the Today page as the home screen.
triggers: Seller completes sign-in
Seller opens the application while already signed in
side_effects: The Today page loads for the signed-in seller's User record
No other page is shown before Today
error_handling: If the session is missing or expired, the seller is sent back to sign-in and is not shown the Today page
If the User record cannot be loaded, the Today page shows an error state with a retry option

business_rules.name: today_page_shows_empty_state_until_records_exist
business_rules.description: A new seller with no customers, invoices, bills or alerts sees an empty Today page that explains what to add next, rather than blank or placeholder figures.
triggers: Seller reaches the Today page with no Invoice, Expense or Alert records for their Shop
side_effects: The Today page shows an empty state with links to add a customer, invoice or upcoming bill
No zero-value balances, forecasts or alerts are invented
error_handling: If the lookup for Invoice, Expense or Alert records fails, the page shows an error state rather than the empty state, so a failed load is not mistaken for no data

business_rules.name: today_page_shows_only_the_signed_in_sellers_data
business_rules.description: The Today page only displays alerts, bills and collections belonging to the Shop of the signed-in seller, and never data from another seller's account.
triggers: Seller opens the Today page
Seller refreshes the Today page
side_effects: Only the seller's own Alert, Invoice and Expense records are listed on the Today page
error_handling: If a record does not match the signed-in seller's Shop, it is excluded silently rather than shown

business_rules.name: today_page_uses_no_demo_or_sample_data_for_real_sellers
business_rules.description: Fictional demo data is never shown on a real seller's Today page; demo records exist only in the isolated public demo.
triggers: Real seller opens the Today page
Seller creates the first customer or invoice
side_effects: The real seller's Today page starts empty and is populated only by their own entered records
error_handling: If demo records are found in a real seller's Shop, they are not displayed and the issue is logged for review

business_rules.name: seller_profile_created_if_missing
business_rules.description: After Clerk verifies the new seller, the server creates the local seller profile for that clerk_user_id only if none exists, then links the session to it.
triggers: Clerk verifies a sign-up
Today page is requested by a signed-in seller
side_effects: One local seller profile is created for the new Clerk user
error_handling: If the profile cannot be created, the seller sees a retryable setup error on Today instead of an empty dashboard

business_rules.name: seller_profile_creation_is_repeat_safe
business_rules.description: Repeated or concurrent requests for the same clerk_user_id never create a second seller profile; clerk_user_id is a unique key on User.
triggers: Repeated page loads
Concurrent requests from the same sign-up
side_effects: The existing profile is reused with its records intact
error_handling: A duplicate attempt reuses the existing profile and shows no error

business_rules.name: seller_profile_setup_error_is_retryable
business_rules.description: If profile setup fails, Today shows a setup error with a retry action that repeats the same safe creation step.
triggers: Profile creation fails on Today
side_effects: The failed attempt creates or changes no business records
error_handling: Retry repeats the safe creation; if it keeps failing, the seller stays on the setup error with a message

steps.description: Seller returns to sign in through Clerk on later visits.

business_rules.name: seller_must_sign_in_to_access_records
business_rules.description: A returning seller must present the email and password of an existing User account before any business records are shown, and an unauthenticated visitor is sent to the login page.
triggers: Seller opens any PocketDash page on a later visit without an active signed-in session
Seller submits the login form
side_effects: On valid credentials, the seller is signed in and taken to the Today page
On invalid credentials, the seller stays on the login page and no business records are shown
Private records (Customer, Invoice, Payment, Expense, Shop, OpeningBalance) remain hidden from anyone not signed in
error_handling: Email is not registered: show a generic 'Email or password is incorrect' message without revealing which one is wrong
Password does not match the stored hash: show the same generic message and keep the entered email in the form
Session has expired or been cleared: redirect to the login page and keep the requested page so the seller can return to it after signing in
Login service or database unavailable: show an error state with a retry option and do not sign the seller in

business_rules.name: demo_account_is_isolated_from_seller_records
business_rules.description: Any public judge demo login reaches only a fictional User account and its fictional records, and can never open the seller's private User records or their data.
triggers: A visitor signs in through the public demo login on the login page
A signed-in demo user attempts to open a private seller account's records
side_effects: The demo session loads only the fictional demo shop and its sample customers, invoices and expenses
Changes made in demo mode do not alter the seller's private records
error_handling: Demo user requests a private seller record by address: show 'Not found' and do not reveal whether the record exists

business_rules.name: successful_sign_in_keeps_saved_records_intact
business_rules.description: Signing in reads the existing User account and its saved records without creating, resetting or re-seeding any of them.
triggers: Seller signs in after an application restart or a browser refresh
side_effects: User.last_signed_in_at is updated to the current time in the Asia/Kolkata timezone
All previously saved Customer, Invoice, Payment, Expense and Settings data is shown as it was left
error_handling: Saved data cannot be read after sign in: show an error state with a retry option rather than an empty workspace that looks like data loss

business_rules.name: login_matches_seller_profile_by_clerk_user_id
business_rules.description: Sign-in finds the seller profile by its linked Clerk user ID rather than by comparing email locally.
triggers: seller submits login form
error_handling: No linked profile: seller sees no business records and is told to sign up

missing: User.clerk_user_id — no column clerk_user_id on users

validation_rules.description: Email is required to sign in and must not be blank after trimming spaces.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the email you used to sign up.

validation_rules.description: Email must contain a single @ with text before it and a domain with a dot after it.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.

name: Password Recovery
description: A seller who forgot their password requests an emailed reset link and sets a new password.

steps.description: Seller taps 'Forgot password' on the login page.

business_rules.name: forgot_password_tap_changes_no_records
business_rules.description: Tapping 'Forgot password' on the login page only opens the recovery entry point and reads or changes no business records (Customer, Invoice, Payment, Expense, Shop, User, or any other).
triggers: Seller taps the 'Forgot password' link on the login page
side_effects: The seller is taken to the password recovery entry point
No invoice, payment, bill, customer or settings data is read into or changed by this step
error_handling: If the recovery entry point fails to load, the seller stays on the login page and sees an error state with a way to retry
If the seller is not signed in, the login page remains the only accessible screen and no private records are shown

steps.description: Seller enters their email and Clerk emails a verification code.

business_rules.name: reset_request_only_for_registered_email
business_rules.description: A password reset link is issued only when the entered email matches an existing User record; otherwise no link is created or sent.
triggers: Seller submits the forgot-password form with an email address
side_effects: If a User has that email, a single-use reset token is stored on that User and a reset link is emailed to the address
If no User has that email, nothing is stored and nothing is sent
error_handling: Email matches no User: no token is created and no email is sent, but the seller sees the same confirmation as a match
Email delivery fails after the token is stored: the stored token is cleared so the seller can request again without a stale link

missing: User.reset_token_expires_at — no column reset_token_expires_at on users

business_rules.name: generic_confirmation_hides_account_existence
business_rules.description: The seller sees the same confirmation message whether or not the entered email belongs to an account.
triggers: Seller submits the forgot-password form, regardless of whether the email exists
side_effects: The seller is shown a message saying that if an account exists for the address, a reset link has been sent
The response timing and wording do not reveal whether the email is registered
error_handling: Unknown email: shows the same confirmation as a known email, with no hint that the address is unregistered
Internal error while processing the request: shows a generic try-again message without indicating account status

business_rules.name: reset_requests_are_rate_limited
business_rules.description: Clerk rate-limits reset requests; the app adds no reset limiter of its own.
triggers: seller requests reset link
error_handling: Too many requests: seller is told to wait before trying again

validation_rules.description: Email address is required before a reset link can be requested.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the email address you use for PocketDash.

validation_rules.description: Email must be a valid address in the form name@domain.tld, after trimming spaces.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.

validation_rules.description: Email must be no longer than 254 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: This email address is too long. Enter a shorter email address.

steps.description: Seller enters the emailed verification code Clerk sent and sets a new password in Clerk's form.

business_rules.name: reset_code_is_single_use
business_rules.description: The emailed verification code works once; a used or expired code is rejected and the seller is asked to request a new one.
triggers: Seller submits a verification code
side_effects: A used or expired code cannot be reused
error_handling: A rejected code shows a message and offers to send a new code from /forgot-password

business_rules.name: new_password_must_meet_minimum_policy
business_rules.description: The new password must be at least 8 characters and must match the confirmation entry before it is accepted, in the sequence: entered → checked against policy → confirmed → saved.
triggers: Seller submits the new password and confirmation fields
side_effects: If the policy passes, User.password_hash is replaced with a hash of the new password
If the policy fails, User.password_hash is unchanged
error_handling: Password shorter than 8 characters: show minimum length message and keep the form open
Confirmation does not match: show mismatch message and keep the form open
Password empty: show required message

business_rules.name: password_change_ends_existing_sessions
business_rules.description: Once a new password is saved, the User's password_changed_at is recorded and any existing sessions created before that moment are no longer accepted.
triggers: New password is successfully saved for the User
side_effects: User.password_changed_at is set to the current time in Asia/Kolkata
Any device still signed in with the old password is signed out on its next request
The seller is taken to sign in with the new password
error_handling: If the session cannot be ended, the password change still stands and the seller is asked to sign in again

business_rules.name: reset_completion_does_not_alter_business_records
business_rules.description: Setting a new password changes only the User's credentials and never changes customers, invoices, payments, expenses, alerts, settings or cash balances.
triggers: New password is successfully saved
side_effects: No Invoice, Payment, Expense, Customer, Shop or Scenario record is modified
Records remain available to the seller after sign-in
error_handling: Any failure during save leaves all business records as they were

validation_rules.description: New password must be at least 8 characters long.
validation_rules.error_message: Password must be at least 8 characters.

validation_rules.description: New password must be entered before the form can be submitted.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a new password.

validation_rules.description: The confirmation field must be filled in before submission.
validation_rules.error_message: Re-enter the new password to confirm.

validation_rules.description: Confirmation must exactly match the new password.
validation_rules.error_message: Passwords do not match.

steps.description: Seller signs in with the new password.

business_rules.name: login_requires_registered_email_and_matching_password
business_rules.description: The seller can sign in only when the entered email matches an existing User record and the entered password matches that user's stored password hash.
triggers: Seller submits the login form with an email and password
side_effects: On success, a signed-in session is started for the seller's User record
User.last_login_at is updated to the current time in Asia/Kolkata
The seller is taken to the Today screen
error_handling: Unknown email or wrong password returns the same generic message, so the form does not reveal which field was wrong
No session is created and no records are shown when credentials fail
The password field is cleared after a failed attempt; the email is kept

business_rules.name: new_password_from_recovery_replaces_old_password_at_login
business_rules.description: After a password recovery completes, the new password is the only valid password for the seller, and the old password is rejected at login.
triggers: Seller signs in on the login page after completing password recovery
Seller enters the old password after recovery
side_effects: Signing in with the new password starts a session for the same User record
Signing in with the old password fails and creates no session
No business records (customers, invoices, expenses, settings) are changed by the login
error_handling: If the new password is rejected, the seller is shown the generic sign-in error and can retry or restart recovery
If the stored hash was not updated during recovery, the seller is prompted to restart password recovery rather than being signed in with the old password

business_rules.name: repeated_failed_logins_are_throttled
business_rules.description: After repeated consecutive failed sign-in attempts for the same email, further attempts are temporarily blocked before the password is checked.
triggers: Seller or another person submits a wrong password several times in a row for the same email
side_effects: User.failed_login_count increases with each failed attempt and resets on a successful sign-in
User.locked_until is set to a short future time once the limit is reached
The seller is told to wait and retry later, or to use password recovery
error_handling: Attempts during the lock period are rejected without checking the password
The lock expires automatically at User.locked_until; no records are changed
A successful sign-in after the lock expires clears User.failed_login_count

business_rules.name: single_seller_account_for_mvp
business_rules.description: The login page signs in only the seller's account; separate helper accounts and permissions are not provided in this MVP.
triggers: Helper attempts to sign in with their own credentials
side_effects: Helper sign-in is treated as an ordinary failed login with no separate helper session
error_handling: Any account that is not the seller's User record is refused with the generic sign-in error

validation_rules.description: Email is required to sign in.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your email address.

validation_rules.description: Email must be a well-formed address such as name@example.com.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.

validation_rules.description: Password is required to sign in.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your password.

validation_rules.description: Password input is limited to a maximum length to avoid oversized submissions; the sign-in form does not reveal the password policy.
validation_rules.error_message: Password is too long. Check it and try again.

name: Profile Update and Sign Out
description: The seller changes their name, email or password, then signs out.

steps.description: Seller opens the profile page and sees their name and email.

business_rules.name: profile_shows_only_signed_in_sellers_details
business_rules.description: The profile page shows the name and email of the currently signed-in seller only, and no other user's User record is ever displayed.
triggers: Seller opens the profile page
side_effects: The page displays the signed-in seller's User.name and User.email as read-only text
No User record is changed by viewing the profile
error_handling: If there is no signed-in session, the seller is sent to sign-in and no profile details are shown
If the User record cannot be loaded, the page shows an error state with a retry option and does not show partial or other users' details
While the User record is loading, the page shows a loading state

business_rules.name: public_demo_profile_uses_fictional_user_only
business_rules.description: When the app runs as the public judge demo, the profile page shows only the fictional demo User record, never a real seller's User.name or User.email.
triggers: Visitor opens the profile page on the public demo deployment
side_effects: The profile page displays the fictional demo seller's name and email
error_handling: If the demo User record is missing, the page shows an empty state explaining that no demo profile is available

steps.description: Seller edits name, email or password and saves the change.

business_rules.name: profile_changes_apply_only_to_own_user_record
business_rules.description: A seller can change only their own name, email and password, and those changes are saved to their own User record and nowhere else.
triggers: Seller submits the profile form with edited name, email or password
side_effects: User.name, User.email or User.password_hash is updated for the signed-in seller only
No Customer, Invoice, Payment, Expense, Shop or other business records are changed
error_handling: If the signed-in session does not belong to the User record being edited, the save is refused and the seller sees an error message
If the save fails partway, the previous name, email and password remain in effect

business_rules.name: email_must_be_unique_across_users
business_rules.description: No two User records may share the same email address, so a new email is accepted only if no other user already has it.
triggers: Seller saves a changed email address on the profile form
side_effects: User.email is updated only when the new address is not already held by another user
Seller's sign-in identity changes to the new email once saved
error_handling: If the email is already in use by another user, the change is rejected and User.email keeps its previous value
If the seller re-saves their own current email, no uniqueness error is shown

business_rules.name: password_change_requires_matching_confirmation_and_is_stored_hashed
business_rules.description: A new password is saved only when the password and its confirmation match, and it is stored as a hash in User.password_hash, never in plain text.
triggers: Seller enters a new password and confirmation on the profile form and saves
side_effects: User.password_hash is replaced with a hash of the new password
Seller signs in with the new password from then on
error_handling: If the confirmation does not match the new password, nothing is saved and the seller is told the passwords differ
If the password field is left blank, User.password_hash is left unchanged

business_rules.name: profile_changes_persist_across_refresh_and_restart
business_rules.description: Saved name, email and password changes remain in effect after page refresh and application restart.
triggers: Seller saves a profile change and then refreshes or restarts the application
side_effects: Profile page shows the saved name and email after reload
The saved password works for the next sign-in
error_handling: If persistence fails, the seller is shown an error and the form keeps the unsaved values so they can retry

business_rules.name: demo_profile_changes_isolated_from_private_account
business_rules.description: Profile edits made in the public judge demo change only the fictional demo User record and never the seller's private User record.
triggers: Seller or visitor edits profile details while using the public demo instance
side_effects: Only the demo environment's User record is updated
The private seller account remains unchanged
error_handling: If a demo session attempts to reach the private account, the request is refused

validation_rules.error_message: Name must be 100 characters or fewer.

steps.description: Seller taps sign out and returns to the login page.

business_rules.name: sign_out_ends_seller_session
business_rules.description: Signing out ends the seller's authenticated session and returns the seller to the login page, so private records are no longer visible on the device.
triggers: Seller taps the sign out control in the app
side_effects: User.session_token is cleared so the session can no longer be used
User.last_signed_out_at is set to the current time
The seller is taken to the login page
error_handling: If the session has already expired when sign out is tapped, the seller is still sent to the login page with no error shown
If ending the session fails, the seller remains signed in, stays on the current page, and sees an error message asking them to try again

business_rules.name: sign_out_preserves_business_records
business_rules.description: Signing out changes only the seller's session and never alters or deletes saved business records such as customers, invoices, payments, bills, alerts or cash settings.
triggers: Seller taps the sign out control in the app
side_effects: All saved customers, invoices, payments, bills, alerts and opening cash balance remain unchanged
The same records are shown again when the seller signs back in
error_handling: If sign out would affect any business record, the operation is stopped and the seller sees an error message while remaining signed in

business_rules.name: protected_pages_require_sign_in_after_sign_out
business_rules.description: After sign out, any attempt to open a protected page (such as Today, Invoices or Cash Forecast) redirects the visitor to the login page until the seller signs in again.
triggers: Seller or another person uses the browser back button after signing out
A protected page URL is opened after sign out
side_effects: Protected pages are not displayed without a valid session
The visitor is redirected to the login page
error_handling: If a cached protected page is shown from browser history, it is replaced with the login page on the next navigation or reload

name: Add and Review a Customer
description: The seller adds a new customer with a name and optional phone or email, then checks their record.

steps.description: Seller opens the customers list and sees balances for saved customers.

business_rules.name: customer_balance_is_sum_of_outstanding_invoices
business_rules.description: A customer's balance is the sum of the outstanding amounts of their invoices, where each invoice's outstanding amount is its total minus recorded payments.
triggers: Seller opens the customers list
A payment is recorded against any of the customer's invoices
An invoice is created, edited, or cancelled for the customer
side_effects: The customers list shows the recalculated balance for that customer
The same outstanding figure appears on the customer detail, invoice detail, collections list, and cash forecast
error_handling: If a customer has no invoices, the balance shows as zero rather than blank
If recorded payments exceed an invoice total, the overpayment is blocked at entry so the balance is never negative from this rule

business_rules.name: draft_and_cancelled_invoices_excluded_from_balances
business_rules.description: Invoices with status draft or cancelled are excluded from customer balances and receivables, and only unpaid, partially paid, and paid invoices contribute to them (draft → unpaid → partially paid → paid, or draft/unpaid → cancelled).
triggers: Seller saves an invoice as a draft
Seller cancels an invoice
Seller opens the customers list with draft or cancelled invoices present
side_effects: A draft invoice does not add to the customer's balance on the customers list
A cancelled invoice is removed from the customer's balance and from receivables
Draft and cancelled invoices are kept out of the cash forecast
error_handling: If an invoice with recorded payments is cancelled, the cancellation is blocked until the payments are reversed or the seller confirms the change, so no payment is silently lost
If a customer's only invoices are drafts, the balance shows as zero with no overdue status

business_rules.name: balance_source_labelled_as_entered_records
business_rules.description: Customer balances are derived only from entered invoice and payment records, and the customers list states that the figure is based on entered records rather than bank-verified money.
triggers: Seller opens the customers list
A manual payment record exists for any customer
side_effects: The customers list shows a note that balances are based on entered records
Manual payments appear labelled as seller-recorded, not bank-verified
error_handling: If no payments have been recorded, the balance equals the full invoice totals and the note still appears

validation_rules.description: The customer search text is limited to 100 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Search is limited to 100 characters.

steps.description: Seller taps add and enters customer name with optional phone or email.

business_rules.name: customer_requires_name
business_rules.description: A customer is saved only when it has a name; no customer record is created without one.
triggers: Seller taps Add on the Customers screen and submits the New Customer form
side_effects: A new Customer record is saved with its name and appears in the Customers list
The new customer becomes selectable when the seller creates an invoice
error_handling: Name is blank or contains only spaces: the form is not submitted, no Customer record is created, and the name field shows an error
Save fails due to a storage error: the entered details stay on the form and an error message is shown so the seller can retry

business_rules.name: customer_contact_details_optional
business_rules.description: Phone and email are optional, so a customer may be saved with a name alone, with either contact detail, or with both.
triggers: Seller submits the New Customer form with phone or email left empty
side_effects: Customer record is saved with empty phone and/or email
Reminder options for that customer are limited to copying the draft, since no phone number is available for a WhatsApp draft
error_handling: Phone and email both empty: the customer is still saved with the name only, with no error shown
Only one contact provided: the customer is saved with that single contact detail

business_rules.name: customer_phone_enables_whatsapp_draft
business_rules.description: A saved customer phone number is what allows a reminder to be opened as a WhatsApp draft; without it, only copying the reminder is offered.
triggers: Seller later opens a reminder draft for an invoice belonging to this customer
side_effects: A WhatsApp draft is offered to the seller when Customer.phone is present
Only copy-to-clipboard is offered when Customer.phone is empty
error_handling: Phone is empty when a reminder is requested: WhatsApp draft option is hidden and the seller is told to add a phone number to the customer
Stored phone is malformed: the WhatsApp draft option is not offered until the phone is corrected on the Customer Detail page

business_rules.name: customer_is_reusable_for_invoices
business_rules.description: Each saved customer is kept as a single record that later invoices, payments and balances are attached to.
triggers: Seller creates a new customer and then selects it on a new invoice
side_effects: Invoices created for this customer reference the saved Customer record rather than retyping its details
The customer's outstanding balance on the Customers list begins at zero until invoices are added
error_handling: Customer saved but later deleted or unavailable: invoices that reference it are not created and the seller is asked to choose or add a customer

validation_rules.description: Customer name is required and cannot be blank or only spaces.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the customer's name.

validation_rules.description: Customer name can be up to 100 characters after trimming leading and trailing spaces.
validation_rules.error_message: Customer name must be 100 characters or fewer.

validation_rules.description: If entered, phone must be a 10-digit Indian mobile number, optionally prefixed with +91 or 0, with spaces or hyphens allowed.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number, for example 98765 43210.

validation_rules.description: If entered, email must follow a standard name@domain format with no spaces.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.

steps.description: Seller views the new customer's detail page with an empty invoice list and zero balance.

business_rules.name: customer_balance_derived_from_open_invoices
business_rules.description: A customer's outstanding balance is the sum of their active invoices' totals minus recorded payments against those invoices, and is zero when the customer has no invoices.
triggers: Seller opens the detail page for a newly created customer with no invoices
Seller opens any customer detail page
side_effects: The customer detail page shows an outstanding balance of ₹0 and an empty invoice list
No invoice, payment or customer record is changed
error_handling: If the customer has no invoices, show ₹0 outstanding with an empty-state message instead of an error
If the invoice lookup for the customer fails, show an error state with a retry option rather than a balance of ₹0

business_rules.name: draft_and_cancelled_invoices_excluded_from_balance
business_rules.description: Invoices with draft or cancelled status are listed on the customer's page but are excluded from the outstanding balance, which counts only issued invoices (unpaid → partially paid → paid).
triggers: Seller opens a customer detail page that contains draft or cancelled invoices
An invoice is saved as draft or cancelled
side_effects: Draft and cancelled invoices appear in the invoice list with their status label but add nothing to the outstanding balance
The customer's balance excludes draft and cancelled amounts
error_handling: If an invoice has an unrecognised status, exclude it from the balance and flag it for review rather than guessing

business_rules.name: balance_formatted_consistently_in_rupees
business_rules.description: The customer's outstanding balance is displayed in Indian rupee formatting using the same calculation and presentation used on every other screen.
triggers: Customer detail page renders the balance summary
side_effects: The balance appears as ₹0 for a new customer with no invoices
error_handling: If the balance cannot be calculated, show a clear error instead of a blank or zero value

name: Create an Itemised Invoice
description: The seller creates an invoice for a saved or new customer using saved item details, with an automatically calculated total.

steps.description: Seller opens new invoice and picks an existing customer or adds one.

business_rules.name: invoice_requires_existing_customer
business_rules.description: An itemised invoice cannot be created until the seller has picked an existing Customer or added a new one, so every Invoice links to exactly one Customer.
triggers: Seller opens the New Invoice page
Seller tries to continue to item entry without choosing a customer
side_effects: Invoice.customer_id is set to the chosen Customer
Invoice is not saved and the customer picker stays open until a customer is chosen
error_handling: No customer selected: block progression and show that a customer is required
Selected customer was deleted or is no longer available: clear the selection and ask the seller to pick again

business_rules.name: reuse_existing_customer_before_creating
business_rules.description: The customer picker searches saved Customer records by name and phone so the seller reuses an existing customer instead of creating a duplicate.
triggers: Seller types in the customer picker on the New Invoice page
Seller is about to add a new customer whose name or phone already matches a saved record
side_effects: Matching saved Customer is selected for the new Invoice
No new Customer record is created when the seller picks a match
error_handling: No matches found: offer to add a new customer with the typed name
Multiple customers share a name: show phone or email to help the seller choose the correct one

business_rules.name: new_customer_created_inline_and_selected
business_rules.description: When the seller adds a customer from the New Invoice page, a Customer record is saved with a name and optional contact details and is immediately selected for the invoice being created.
triggers: Seller chooses to add a new customer from the New Invoice page and submits the customer form
side_effects: A new Customer record is saved under the seller's account
The new Customer becomes the selected customer on the invoice in progress
The customer remains available for future invoices after a refresh or restart
error_handling: Name missing: keep the form open with a name-required message and do not save the Customer
Save fails: keep the typed details on screen and show a retry message without creating a partial Customer

business_rules.name: customer_contact_optional_drives_reminder_channel
business_rules.description: Customer phone and email are optional; a customer without a phone number can still be invoiced, but reminders for that customer are copy-only rather than offered as a WhatsApp draft.
triggers: Seller adds a new customer without a phone number
Seller selects an existing customer with no phone number on the New Invoice page
side_effects: Customer is saved and selectable without contact details
Later reminder screens offer copy-only for this customer
error_handling: Phone left blank: accept the customer and do not show a validation error
Phone entered in an invalid format: block saving and explain the expected format

business_rules.name: customer_balance_derived_from_invoices
business_rules.description: A customer's outstanding balance is never typed in; it is derived from their non-draft, non-cancelled invoices minus recorded payments, so creating or selecting a customer does not change any balance or cash figure.
triggers: Seller creates a new Customer on the New Invoice page
Seller selects an existing Customer for a new Invoice
side_effects: New customer starts with a zero outstanding balance
Selecting a customer shows their existing outstanding balance for reference only
error_handling: Balance cannot be computed because invoice data failed to load: show the balance as unavailable rather than zero

business_rules.name: customer_records_private_to_seller
business_rules.description: Every Customer belongs to the seller's account, and customers created or searched on the New Invoice page are visible only to that account.
triggers: Seller creates a new Customer
Seller searches the customer picker
side_effects: Customer is stored with the seller's User reference
Search results include only the seller's own customers
error_handling: Session expired while saving: reject the save and ask the seller to sign in again without storing an unowned Customer

validation_rules.description: An existing customer or a newly added customer must be selected before the invoice can continue.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose a customer for this invoice.

validation_rules.description: A new customer must have a name of 1 to 80 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the customer's name (up to 80 characters).

validation_rules.description: Customer name is limited to 80 characters after trimming leading and trailing spaces.
validation_rules.error_message: Customer name must be 80 characters or fewer.

validation_rules.description: If entered, the phone number must be a 10-digit Indian mobile number starting with 6 to 9, optionally prefixed with +91 or 0; the field may be left blank.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number, or leave it blank.

validation_rules.description: If entered, the email must be in a valid address format; the field may be left blank.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, or leave it blank.

steps.description: Seller adds items such as printed T-shirts, crochet gifts or delivery charges, picking saved items where possible.

business_rules.name: invoice_item_line_total_is_quantity_times_unit_price
business_rules.description: Each InvoiceItem's line total is its quantity multiplied by its unit price in rupees, and the Invoice total is the sum of its line totals.
triggers: Seller adds an item to an invoice
Seller changes the quantity or unit price of an item
Seller removes an item from an invoice
side_effects: InvoiceItem.line_total is recalculated from quantity and unit_price
Invoice.total_amount is recalculated as the sum of all its InvoiceItem.line_total values
the invoice total shown in the item list and preview updates immediately
error_handling: If quantity or unit_price is missing or invalid, line_total is not calculated and the item is not saved
If an item is removed, Invoice.total_amount drops by that item's line_total without leaving a stale total

business_rules.name: saved_item_details_copy_into_invoice_item
business_rules.description: Picking a saved item pre-fills InvoiceItem.description and InvoiceItem.unit_price on the invoice, and the copied values are stored on that invoice item independently of the saved item.
triggers: Seller picks a previously used item from the ItemPicker
Seller edits a pre-filled item description or price on the invoice
side_effects: a new InvoiceItem is created on the current invoice with the picked description and unit price
the seller can change the copied price or quantity for this invoice only
earlier invoices keep their original item descriptions and prices
error_handling: If the picked saved item no longer exists, the seller is shown an error and the item is not added
If the seller clears a pre-filled description, the item cannot be saved until a description is entered

business_rules.name: delivery_charge_is_an_invoice_item_not_payment
business_rules.description: Delivery charges are added as InvoiceItems alongside printed T-shirts and crochet gifts and count toward the invoice total, but adding a delivery charge does not record any payment or change cash.
triggers: Seller adds a delivery charge item to an invoice
Seller marks an order as delivered
side_effects: Invoice.total_amount increases by the delivery charge
no Payment record is created
the outstanding balance on the invoice increases by the delivery charge once the invoice is issued
error_handling: If a delivery item is entered with a zero price, it is saved as a zero-value line and the total is unchanged
Delivery status does not change the invoice's payment status

business_rules.name: draft_invoice_items_stay_out_of_receivables
business_rules.description: InvoiceItems on a draft invoice do not contribute to receivables or cash forecasts until the invoice is issued, and changes to draft items never alter the outstanding balance shown elsewhere.
triggers: Seller adds, edits or removes items on a draft invoice
Seller opens the collections list or cash forecast while a draft invoice is being built
side_effects: the draft invoice total is shown only on the invoice itself
receivables and the cash forecast exclude the draft invoice's items
once the invoice is issued, its item total becomes the outstanding balance base
error_handling: If the seller tries to issue an invoice with no items, the invoice stays as a draft and the seller is told to add at least one item
If a draft is cancelled, its items are excluded from all receivables and forecasts

validation_rules.error_message: Enter a description for this item, for example 'Printed T-shirt' or 'Delivery charge'.

validation_rules.error_message: Quantity must be a whole number of 1 or more.

validation_rules.description: Unit price is in rupees, zero or greater, with up to two decimal places for paise.
validation_rules.error_message: Unit price must be ₹0 or more, with no more than two decimal places.

validation_rules.error_message: The line total could not be calculated. Check the quantity and unit price and try again.

steps.description: Seller sets invoice number, issue date, due date and optional notes, with optional fields collapsed by default.

business_rules.name: invoice_number_must_be_unique
business_rules.description: Each invoice carries a seller-set invoice number that no other invoice in the shop uses.
triggers: Seller enters or edits the invoice number on the New Invoice form
Seller saves the invoice
side_effects: Invoice is saved with the invoice number only if no other invoice has it
Seller sees the duplicate-number message and the invoice is not created
error_handling: Invoice number already used by another invoice: block save and show the duplicate-number message next to the field
Invoice number left blank: block save and ask for a number
Duplicate submission of the same form: the second save is rejected so only one invoice with that number exists

business_rules.name: due_date_must_not_be_before_issue_date
business_rules.description: The payment due date must fall on or after the issue date, both read on the Asia/Kolkata calendar.
triggers: Seller sets or changes the issue date or due date
Seller saves the invoice
side_effects: Invoice.due_date is stored only when it is on or after Invoice.issue_date
Overdue calculations for the invoice use the stored due date
error_handling: Due date earlier than issue date: block save and show the date-order message on the due date field
Issue date changed after due date was set so that due date is now earlier: block save until the due date is corrected

business_rules.name: invoice_starts_as_draft_until_saved_as_issued
business_rules.description: A newly created invoice begins in draft status and is kept out of receivables and forecasts until it is issued.
triggers: Seller completes the invoice details step and saves the invoice
Seller leaves the form with the invoice unsaved
side_effects: Invoice.status is set to draft on creation
Draft invoice does not appear in outstanding balances, collections lists, or cash forecasts
Creating the invoice does not change available cash
error_handling: Seller abandons the form before saving: no invoice record is created and no receivable is shown
Invoice saved as draft with missing required dates: save is blocked until the dates are present

business_rules.name: optional_fields_collapsed_without_blocking_save
business_rules.description: Notes are optional and kept collapsed by default, and leaving them empty never blocks saving the invoice.
triggers: Seller opens the New Invoice page
Seller saves with the optional section collapsed
side_effects: Invoice.notes is stored as empty when not filled in
Notes appear on the invoice preview only when they contain text
error_handling: Notes exceed the allowed length: block save and show the character limit

validation_rules.description: An invoice number must be entered before the invoice can be saved.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter an invoice number.

validation_rules.description: The invoice number must not match any other invoice's number in the shop.
validation_rules.error_message: This invoice number is already used. Enter a different number.

validation_rules.description: The invoice number is at most 30 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Invoice number must be 30 characters or fewer.

validation_rules.description: An issue date must be selected before saving.
validation_rules.error_message: Select an issue date.

validation_rules.description: A payment due date must be selected before saving.
validation_rules.error_message: Select a payment due date.

validation_rules.description: The due date must be on or after the issue date.
validation_rules.error_message: Due date cannot be before the issue date.

validation_rules.description: Optional notes are at most 500 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Notes must be 500 characters or fewer.

steps.description: Seller saves the invoice and lands on its detail page showing total and outstanding balance.

business_rules.name: invoice_total_is_sum_of_items
business_rules.description: An invoice's total is the sum of its item lines, each quantity multiplied by unit price, and is recalculated automatically when items change.
triggers: Seller saves a new invoice and lands on its detail page
Seller edits an invoice's items and saves
side_effects: Invoice.total is stored and shown as the invoice total on the detail page
Invoice.total feeds the outstanding balance and collections list
error_handling: If an item has a missing or non-positive quantity or unit price, the invoice is not saved and the seller is told which item is invalid
If item data cannot be loaded, the detail page shows an error state instead of a total of zero

business_rules.name: outstanding_balance_is_total_minus_recorded_payments
business_rules.description: The outstanding balance of an invoice is its total minus the sum of all recorded payments, and it is shown identically on every screen.
triggers: Seller opens the invoice detail page after saving
A payment is recorded against the invoice
An invoice total is changed
side_effects: The detail page shows the outstanding balance as total minus recorded payments
Invoice.status is updated to unpaid, partially paid or paid to match the balance
Collections list, customer balance and forecasts use the same outstanding figure
error_handling: If the payment sum cannot be loaded, the detail page shows an error state rather than a balance equal to the full total
If payments would make the balance negative, the record is rejected elsewhere and the detail page keeps the last valid balance

business_rules.name: invoice_status_progresses_unpaid_to_paid
business_rules.description: Invoice status moves through draft → unpaid → partially paid → paid as payments are recorded, and overdue is shown separately whenever an unpaid balance remains after the due date.
triggers: Seller saves a new invoice and lands on its detail page
A payment or advance is recorded
The current date passes the invoice due date (Asia/Kolkata)
side_effects: The detail page shows a clear status label such as Unpaid, Partially paid, Paid or Overdue
Overdue invoices are listed separately from invoices not yet due
Overdue alerts appear while a balance remains and clear once the balance is zero
error_handling: If the due date is missing, the invoice is not treated as overdue and the detail page flags the missing due date
If status cannot be determined, the page shows a neutral status with an error note rather than a misleading label

business_rules.name: draft_and_cancelled_invoices_excluded_from_receivables
business_rules.description: Invoices with draft or cancelled status are excluded from outstanding receivables, collections lists and cash forecasts.
triggers: Seller saves an invoice as a draft
Seller cancels an invoice
Cash forecast or collections list is calculated
side_effects: A draft or cancelled invoice shows its total but no outstanding receivable on the detail page
The invoice does not appear in the collections list or in forecast collections
error_handling: If a cancelled invoice has recorded payments, the payments are kept and shown, but the invoice is still excluded from receivables
If status is unknown, the invoice is excluded from receivables until its status is confirmed

business_rules.name: invoice_creation_does_not_increase_cash
business_rules.description: Saving an invoice creates a receivable only and never increases available cash; cash rises only when a Payment is recorded.
triggers: Seller saves a new invoice and lands on its detail page
Cash balance or forecast is displayed
side_effects: The detail page shows the amount as owed, not as cash received
Available cash on Today and Cash Forecast is unchanged until a Payment is recorded
error_handling: If a payment is never recorded, available cash stays unchanged even if the customer says they will pay
If the seller tries to treat the invoice total as cash, the page keeps it labelled as outstanding

business_rules.name: invoice_number_unique_per_shop
business_rules.description: Each invoice has a unique invoice number that is displayed on the detail page and never reused for another invoice.
triggers: Seller saves a new invoice and lands on its detail page
side_effects: The detail page shows the invoice number used in reminders and printed previews
The invoice can be found by number on the Invoices page
error_handling: If the invoice number already exists, the save is rejected and the seller is asked to use a different number
If the invoice number is missing, the detail page shows an error and the invoice cannot be referenced in reminders

business_rules.name: due_date_and_overdue_use_asia_kolkata_calendar
business_rules.description: The invoice due date is stored as a calendar date and overdue status is evaluated against the current Asia/Kolkata calendar day.
triggers: Invoice detail page is loaded
Daily check for overdue invoices runs
side_effects: The detail page shows days overdue based on the Asia/Kolkata date
Overdue alerts are raised or cleared on the Asia/Kolkata day boundary
error_handling: If the due date is in the past at the moment of saving, the invoice is shown as overdue immediately with the days overdue count
If the device time zone differs, the Asia/Kolkata calendar still governs the overdue calculation

name: Record Advance and Final Payments
description: The seller records an advance and then the remaining payment, and the outstanding balance updates everywhere.

steps.description: Seller opens an invoice showing total and still to pay.

business_rules.name: outstanding_balance_is_total_minus_recorded_payments
business_rules.description: The amount still to pay on an invoice is its total minus the sum of all recorded payments, and this same figure is shown everywhere the invoice appears.
triggers: Seller opens the invoice detail page
A payment is recorded or changed against the invoice
side_effects: Invoice.outstanding_amount is recalculated and shown as the still-to-pay figure on the invoice, the customer's balance, the collections list and the cash forecast
Alerts tied to the invoice are updated when the outstanding amount reaches zero
error_handling: If the sum of payments exceeds the invoice total, the outstanding amount is not shown as negative and the overpayment is blocked at entry
If the invoice has no payments, the outstanding amount equals the full total

business_rules.name: invoice_payment_status_follows_balance
business_rules.description: Invoice.status moves through draft → unpaid → partially_paid → paid based on recorded payments, while cancelled is a separate terminal state that stops all balance tracking.
triggers: Seller opens the invoice detail page
A payment is recorded, edited or removed
The invoice is cancelled
side_effects: Invoice.status is shown as unpaid when no payment exists, partially_paid when some payment exists and balance remains, and paid when the outstanding amount is zero
A cancelled invoice displays as cancelled and is removed from receivables

If the status cannot be determined from payments, the invoice is shown as unpaid by default

business_rules.name: overdue_when_balance_remains_after_due_date
business_rules.description: An invoice is flagged overdue only when it has an outstanding balance greater than zero and the current Asia/Kolkata date is after Invoice.due_date, and overdue is shown separately from the payment status.
triggers: Seller opens the invoice detail page
The calendar date passes an invoice's due date with a balance still owed
A payment reduces the outstanding amount to zero
side_effects: The invoice shows an overdue label with days overdue counted in the Asia/Kolkata calendar
Invoice.status remains unpaid or partially_paid while overdue is displayed alongside it
An overdue invoice alert is created or resolved according to the balance
error_handling: If the due date is missing, the invoice is not flagged overdue and a missing due date is shown instead
If the balance is zero, the overdue flag is removed even if the due date has passed

business_rules.name: draft_and_cancelled_invoices_excluded_from_receivables
business_rules.description: Invoices with status draft or cancelled are kept out of outstanding balances, overdue status, reminders and cash forecasts.
triggers: Seller opens an invoice that is still a draft or has been cancelled
Receivables totals or the cash forecast are recalculated
side_effects: A draft or cancelled invoice displays its total but shows no receivable outstanding amount and no overdue flag
The invoice is excluded from collections lists and forecast inflows
error_handling: If a draft invoice has payments recorded, the payments are kept but the invoice stays out of receivables until it is issued

business_rules.name: invoice_creation_does_not_increase_cash
business_rules.description: Issuing an invoice or marking it delivered does not change cash; only recorded Payment records add to received cash.
triggers: Seller opens an invoice that has been issued or delivered
Invoice.status changes to unpaid after issue
side_effects: The invoice total is shown as receivable, not as cash on hand
Available cash on the forecast is unaffected until a Payment is recorded
error_handling: If a seller expects cash from a delivered invoice that has no payment, the balance remains displayed as still to pay

business_rules.name: payments_labelled_seller_recorded
business_rules.description: Each payment shown on the invoice is labelled as seller-recorded and not bank-verified, because the seller entered it manually.
triggers: Seller opens the invoice detail page with payment history
A payment is recorded against the invoice
side_effects: Each payment line displays the amount, date, method and the label seller-recorded, not bank-verified
error_handling: If a payment has no method recorded, it is still shown with its amount and date and the method is displayed as not specified

business_rules.name: payment_recorded_as_seller_recorded

triggers: Seller submits the payment form on an invoice to record an advance
side_effects: Payment.verification_status is set to seller_recorded
The payment appears in the invoice's payment history with a seller-recorded label
The payment is not presented as bank-verified anywhere in the app
error_handling: If the payment cannot be saved, no payment record is created and the seller sees an error message with the amount still unrecorded
A payment can never be saved without a verification_status of seller_recorded in this MVP

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: advance_reduces_invoice_outstanding_balance
business_rules.description: A recorded advance reduces the invoice's outstanding balance to invoice total minus all recorded payments, and the invoice status moves from unpaid to partially paid (unpaid → partially paid → paid).
triggers: A valid advance payment is saved against an invoice
side_effects: The outstanding balance shown on the invoice, customer, collections list and forecast becomes invoice total minus recorded payments
Invoice.status becomes partially paid while a balance remains
Invoice.status becomes paid when the outstanding balance reaches zero
error_handling: If the invoice's status cannot be updated after the payment is saved, the balance is recalculated from payments on next load so the displayed figure is not left stale

business_rules.name: payment_cannot_exceed_outstanding_balance
business_rules.description: A payment amount must be greater than zero and cannot exceed the invoice's current outstanding balance, so no invoice is overpaid.
triggers: Seller enters a payment amount on an invoice
side_effects: If valid, the payment is saved and the outstanding balance is reduced
If invalid, nothing is saved and the seller is asked to correct the amount
error_handling: Amount above the outstanding balance is rejected with a message stating the maximum that can be recorded
Zero or negative amount is rejected
Concurrent payments that together would exceed the balance are rejected for the later submission, which is rechecked against the saved balance at save time

business_rules.name: duplicate_payment_submission_prevented
business_rules.description: A single payment form submission creates exactly one payment record, even if the seller taps submit more than once or the connection is slow.
triggers: Seller taps the record payment button more than once
Seller resubmits after a slow or failed response
side_effects: Only one Payment record is saved for the submission
The button is disabled while the submission is in progress
error_handling: A repeated submission with the same details is ignored and the seller sees the single recorded payment
If the first submission is not confirmed, the seller is shown the current balance before retrying so they can check whether it was saved

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: payment_affects_cash_only_after_opening_balance_date
business_rules.description: A recorded payment is counted as an actual receipt in available cash only when its payment date is on or after the OpeningBalance effective date, so amounts already included in the opening balance are not counted twice.
triggers: A payment is saved with a payment date
Available cash is recalculated
side_effects: Available cash includes the payment amount if its payment date is on or after the effective date
Payments dated before the effective date are excluded from available cash but remain in invoice history
error_handling: If no OpeningBalance exists, the payment is kept in invoice history and is not added to available cash until an opening balance is set

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: payment_date_uses_asia_kolkata_calendar
business_rules.description: The payment date is interpreted in the Asia/Kolkata calendar and is used consistently for overdue status and cash calculations.
triggers: Seller enters or confirms a payment date
Overdue status or cash balance is recalculated after a payment
side_effects: Invoice status and overdue state reflect the Asia/Kolkata calendar day of the payment
error_handling: A payment dated in a different timezone calendar is still stored as the Asia/Kolkata date the seller selected

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: payment_clears_overdue_alert_when_balance_zero
business_rules.description: When a payment brings an invoice's outstanding balance to zero, the invoice's overdue alert is resolved without contacting the customer or changing any due date.

side_effects: The overdue invoice alert for that invoice is resolved and no longer appears on the Today screen
Invoice.status becomes paid
The invoice's due_date is left unchanged
error_handling: If the alert cannot be updated, it is recalculated from the invoice balance the next time alerts load
