business_rules.name: outstanding_balance_is_total_minus_recorded_payments
business_rules.description: An invoice's outstanding balance equals its total minus the sum of all recorded payments against it, and that same figure is shown on the invoice page and the customer page.
triggers: Seller records an advance, partial payment or final payment on an invoice
Seller opens the Customer Detail page and views the invoice list or outstanding total
Seller opens the Invoice Detail page after a payment is recorded
side_effects: Invoice.outstanding_amount is recalculated from Invoice.total_amount minus the sum of Payment.amount for that invoice
The still-to-pay figure on the Customer Detail page drops by the same amount, for example from ₹3,000 to ₹2,000 after a ₹1,000 advance
The customer's total outstanding balance is updated to match the invoice balances
error_handling: If the recorded payments total more than the invoice total, the balance must not go negative; the payment is rejected before it is saved
If a payment record fails to save, the previous outstanding balance remains displayed and the seller sees an error message
If the invoice page and customer page show different balances after a refresh, the balance is recomputed from stored payments rather than cached values

business_rules.name: invoice_payment_status_follows_recorded_payments
business_rules.description: An invoice moves through unpaid → partially paid → paid as payments are recorded, and becomes paid only when its outstanding balance reaches zero.
triggers: Seller records the first payment on an unpaid invoice
Seller records a further payment that leaves a balance
Seller records a payment that clears the full outstanding balance
side_effects: Invoice.status becomes partially paid after a ₹1,000 advance on a ₹3,000 invoice
Invoice.status becomes paid when the remaining ₹2,000 is recorded and the outstanding balance reaches zero
The invoice is removed from the receivables and collections lists once it is paid
error_handling: If a status update fails after a payment is saved, the status is recalculated from the stored payments on next load
If the invoice is draft or cancelled, payments cannot change its status and the seller is told it is not receivable

business_rules.name: overdue_only_when_balance_remains_after_due_date
business_rules.description: An invoice is shown as overdue only when an outstanding balance remains and today's date in Asia/Kolkata is after its due date; overdue is displayed separately from the unpaid, partially paid and paid statuses.
triggers: Seller views the Customer Detail page or Invoice Detail page after the due date has passed
A payment reduces the outstanding balance to zero on an invoice that was past due
side_effects: The invoice shows an overdue label alongside its partially paid status when a balance remains past the due date
The overdue label disappears when the outstanding balance reaches zero
The days overdue figure is calculated from Invoice.due_date using the Asia/Kolkata calendar
error_handling: If Invoice.due_date is missing, the invoice is not marked overdue and the seller is shown that a due date is required
If the balance is zero, the invoice is never shown as overdue regardless of its due date

business_rules.name: receivables_exclude_draft_and_cancelled_invoices
business_rules.description: Only issued invoices that are not draft or cancelled contribute to the outstanding balance shown on invoice and customer pages.
triggers: Seller views the Customer Detail page with draft or cancelled invoices present
Seller views the invoice list showing outstanding amounts
side_effects: Draft and cancelled invoices are listed but their amounts are not added to the customer's still-to-pay total
Cancelling an invoice removes its balance from the customer's outstanding total
error_handling: If a payment is attempted against a draft invoice, it is rejected and the invoice balance is unchanged
If a cancelled invoice holds recorded payments, its balance is excluded and the payments remain visible in history

business_rules.name: payments_are_seller_recorded_not_bank_verified
business_rules.description: Every recorded payment is labelled as seller-recorded and not bank-verified wherever its amount reduces the outstanding balance.
triggers: Seller views payment history on the Customer Detail page after a payment is recorded
Seller views the Invoice Detail page after a payment reduces the balance
side_effects: Each payment in the history is labelled seller-recorded beside its amount
The outstanding balance is presented as based on seller-entered records
error_handling: If a payment has no label, the history shows it as seller-recorded by default

business_rules.description: A recorded payment may not be larger than the invoice's outstanding balance, where outstanding is Invoice.total minus the sum of Payment.amount for that invoice.
triggers: Seller submits a payment amount on the Invoice Detail page
side_effects: If the amount is accepted, a Payment record is saved against the invoice and the outstanding balance is recalculated

error_handling: Amount greater than the outstanding balance: reject the payment and show the outstanding amount the seller can record
Amount of zero or less: reject the payment (see amount validation)
Another payment was recorded in the meantime and the outstanding balance is now lower: reject and show the updated outstanding balance

business_rules.name: invoice_status_follows_outstanding_balance
business_rules.description: Invoice.status moves through unpaid → partially_paid → paid based on the outstanding balance after each recorded payment, and overdue is shown separately while an unpaid balance remains past Invoice.due_date.
triggers: A payment is recorded against an invoice
The invoice due date passes with a balance still outstanding
side_effects: When the outstanding balance reaches zero, Invoice.status becomes paid
When some but not all of the total is paid, Invoice.status becomes partially_paid
The invoice's overdue state is cleared once it is paid
error_handling: Payment makes balance zero but a due-date alert is still open: resolve the alert in the same action
Invoice is draft or cancelled: payments are not accepted and status is not changed

business_rules.name: fully_paid_invoice_resolves_overdue_alert
business_rules.description: When an invoice's outstanding balance reaches zero, any open overdue invoice alert linked to that invoice is resolved, so the alert no longer appears on Today or the Invoices list.
triggers: A payment is recorded that brings the outstanding balance to zero
side_effects: Alert.status becomes resolved for the overdue invoice alert linked to this invoice
The invoice's overdue reminder draft is no longer offered as a pending action
The invoice is removed from the overdue collections list and from dated forecast collections
error_handling: No open alert exists for the invoice: nothing to resolve, and the payment still saves
Alert update fails after the payment is saved: the payment remains recorded and the alert is resolved on next load because the balance is zero

side_effects: The payment appears in the invoice's payment history labelled seller-recorded, not bank-verified
error_handling: Payment method left blank: the payment is not saved and the seller is asked to choose a method

business_rules.name: payment_submission_is_idempotent
business_rules.description: A single payment submission creates exactly one Payment record, even if the seller taps the button more than once or the request is repeated.
triggers: Seller double-clicks or re-submits the payment form
Network retry sends the same payment request twice
side_effects: Only one Payment record is saved and the outstanding balance is reduced once
error_handling: Duplicate submission detected: return the existing payment result and do not create a second Payment
Submit button is disabled while a payment is being saved

business_rules.name: settled_invoice_excluded_from_forecast
business_rules.description: Once an invoice's outstanding balance is zero, it contributes nothing to dated or unscheduled expected collections in the cash forecast.
triggers: A payment brings Invoice.status to paid
The cash forecast is recalculated
side_effects: The invoice's remaining balance is removed from 30-, 60- and 90-day expected collections
The invoice no longer appears in the unscheduled overdue list
error_handling: Expected collection date was set before payment: the date is ignored for a paid invoice

Date rolls over in Asia/Kolkata while an invoice remains unpaid

side_effects: Draft and cancelled invoices are hidden from the collections groups

business_rules.name: collections_list_separates_overdue_from_not_yet_due
business_rules.description: The invoices list places overdue unpaid invoices in a separate group from unpaid or partially paid invoices whose due date has not passed, and paid invoices are not shown as receivables.

business_rules.name: search_matches_customer_name_or_invoice_number

error_handling: If nothing matches, the page shows a no-matches empty state with an option to clear the search
Search never changes any saved record

side_effects: The printed status label matches the status shown on the invoice detail screen
An overdue label appears on the printout only when an unpaid balance remains after the due date, using Asia/Kolkata dates
error_handling: If the due date is missing, the preview omits the overdue label and shows a due-date-missing notice rather than guessing

business_rules.name: draft_and_cancelled_invoices_are_labelled_on_print
business_rules.description: Draft and cancelled invoices can be previewed, but the printout is marked as draft or cancelled, and a cancelled invoice is not presented as a payment request.
triggers: Seller previews a draft invoice
Seller previews a cancelled invoice
side_effects: The printout shows a DRAFT or CANCELLED label in place of a payment-due heading
Draft and cancelled invoices remain excluded from receivables and forecasts
error_handling: If the status is unrecognised, the preview shows the raw status with a warning and does not present the invoice as payable

business_rules.name: manual_payments_labelled_seller_recorded
business_rules.description: Each payment listed on the printout is labelled as seller-recorded and not bank-verified, with its amount, date and payment method.
triggers: Seller opens the invoice preview
Seller prints the invoice or saves it as PDF
side_effects: The payments section of the printout shows each payment with the seller-recorded label
error_handling: If a payment has no payment method, the printout shows the payment with method marked as not recorded rather than omitting it

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: printout_uses_saved_shop_and_customer_details
business_rules.description: The printout takes the shop name and contact details from Shop settings and the customer name and contact details from the linked Customer record, so the invoice shows current details without retyping.
triggers: Seller opens the invoice preview
Seller prints the invoice or saves it as PDF
side_effects: The printout header shows the shop details and the bill-to section shows the customer details
Optional customer phone or email is omitted from the printout when blank
error_handling: If shop details are not set, the preview prompts the seller to add them in Settings before printing
If the linked customer is missing, the preview shows an error and does not print an invoice without a customer

business_rules.name: currency_and_dates_formatted_for_print
business_rules.description: All amounts on the printout use Indian rupee formatting and all dates use the Asia/Kolkata calendar.
triggers: Seller opens the invoice preview
Seller prints the invoice or saves it as PDF
side_effects: Amounts appear as rupee values, and issue, due and payment dates appear as Asia/Kolkata calendar dates
error_handling: If a date is missing or invalid, the preview shows a placeholder and flags it instead of printing a wrong date

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

name: Chase an Overdue Invoice
description: The seller works the collections list, drafts a reminder from invoice details, hands it off to WhatsApp or copy, and records the follow-up sent.

steps.description: Seller opens collections and sees overdue invoices sorted by amount and days overdue, with last follow-up.

business_rules.name: overdue_invoices_listed_separately_from_not_yet_due
business_rules.description: An invoice appears in the overdue collections list only when its outstanding balance is greater than zero and its due date is before today in Asia/Kolkata (unpaid → partially paid → overdue when an unpaid balance remains after the due date), while invoices not yet due are kept in a separate group.
triggers: Seller opens the Collections page
Seller returns to the Collections page after recording a payment or follow-up
side_effects: Overdue invoices are shown in the overdue group with their days overdue
Invoices with a due date today or later are shown in the not-yet-due group, not the overdue group
error_handling: If an invoice has no due date, it is not treated as overdue and is shown with a missing-due-date label instead of a days-overdue count
If the invoice has no outstanding balance, it is left off the collections list

business_rules.name: outstanding_balance_is_total_minus_recorded_payments
business_rules.description: The outstanding amount shown for each invoice is the invoice total minus the sum of its recorded payments, using the same figure everywhere in the app.
triggers: Seller opens the Collections page
A payment is recorded against an invoice
side_effects: Each collections row shows the current outstanding amount in Indian rupee format
Invoices whose outstanding amount reaches zero drop off the collections list
error_handling: If recorded payments exceed the invoice total, the outstanding amount is shown as zero and the overpayment is flagged for review rather than shown as a negative balance
If a payment record cannot be read, the invoice is shown with an error state instead of an incorrect balance

business_rules.name: collections_sorted_by_outstanding_amount_and_days_overdue
business_rules.description: Overdue invoices are ordered by outstanding amount (largest first) and then by days overdue (longest first), with the same ordering applied when several customers are late at once.
triggers: Seller opens the Collections page
Seller changes the sort option on the collections list
side_effects: The most valuable and most overdue invoices appear at the top of the list
The order is recalculated from the current balances and due dates
error_handling: If two invoices have the same outstanding amount, they are ordered by days overdue, then by invoice number, so the order is stable
If the sort option is unavailable, the list falls back to outstanding amount descending

business_rules.name: draft_and_cancelled_invoices_excluded_from_collections
business_rules.description: Invoices with draft or cancelled status are kept out of the collections list and of all receivable totals.
triggers: Seller opens the Collections page
An invoice is saved as draft or cancelled
side_effects: Draft and cancelled invoices do not appear in the overdue or not-yet-due groups
Totals on the Collections page include only unpaid, partially paid and overdue invoices
error_handling: If an invoice changes from draft to issued, it appears in collections on the next page load if it is overdue or unpaid

business_rules.name: last_follow_up_reflects_only_recorded_sent_follow_ups
business_rules.description: The last follow-up shown for each invoice is the most recent follow-up the seller has recorded as sent; opening or copying a reminder draft does not count.
triggers: Seller opens the Collections page
Seller records a follow-up as sent on an invoice
side_effects: The collections row shows the date and channel of the most recent recorded follow-up
Invoices with no recorded follow-up show as never followed up
error_handling: If no follow-up has been recorded, the row shows a never-followed-up label instead of a blank or a date
If a follow-up record has no sent date, it is ignored when choosing the last follow-up

missing: FollowUp.sent_at — no table for FollowUp
FollowUp.invoice_id — no table for FollowUp

steps.description: Seller opens an overdue invoice and taps 'Send reminder' to see an editable draft using real invoice details.

business_rules.name: reminder_draft_uses_live_invoice_figures
business_rules.description: The reminder draft is generated from the invoice's current customer name, invoice number, due date, days overdue and outstanding balance (total minus recorded payments), so it always matches the records.
triggers: Seller opens an overdue invoice and taps 'Send reminder'
Seller reopens an existing reminder draft for the same invoice
side_effects: Reminder.body is populated with the customer name, invoice number, outstanding balance in rupees, due date and days overdue
Reminder.invoice_id links the draft to the invoice
error_handling: If the invoice has no outstanding balance, no draft is generated and the seller sees that the invoice is fully paid
If the invoice is not yet due, the draft is not offered as an overdue reminder and the seller is told the invoice is not overdue
If the invoice is draft or cancelled, it is excluded and no reminder is created

business_rules.name: opening_or_copying_draft_does_not_mark_sent
business_rules.description: Opening, editing or copying a reminder draft does not record a follow-up as sent; only an explicit 'record follow-up sent' action does that.
triggers: Seller views the reminder draft
Seller copies the reminder text
Seller opens a WhatsApp draft from the reminder
side_effects: Reminder.status becomes copied or opened, not sent
No FollowUp record is created and the invoice's last-follow-up entry is unchanged
error_handling: If the copy action fails, the draft stays unchanged and the seller sees an error message with a retry option

missing: FollowUp.sent_at — no table for FollowUp

business_rules.name: reminder_edits_do_not_change_invoice_records
business_rules.description: Changes the seller makes to the reminder text are saved only to the draft and never alter the invoice's amounts, due date, status or payments.
triggers: Seller edits the reminder draft text and saves
side_effects: Reminder.body stores the edited text
Invoice fields and Payment records remain unchanged
error_handling: If saving the draft fails, the edited text is kept on screen and the seller is asked to retry

business_rules.name: whatsapp_option_requires_customer_phone
business_rules.description: The WhatsApp draft option is offered only when the invoice's customer has a phone number; otherwise the seller can only copy the reminder.
triggers: Seller taps the WhatsApp draft option on a reminder
side_effects: A WhatsApp draft opens with the reminder text pre-filled for the customer's phone number
Nothing is sent automatically; the seller reviews and sends it themselves
error_handling: If the customer has no phone number, the WhatsApp option is hidden and the seller is told to add a phone number or copy the text instead

business_rules.name: reminder_draft_reflects_payments_recorded_at_time
business_rules.description: When the draft is opened, the outstanding balance is recalculated from all payments recorded so far, and a draft created earlier is refreshed to show the current balance before use.
triggers: Seller records a payment and then opens or reopens the reminder draft
Seller opens a draft that was created before a new payment
side_effects: Reminder.body shows the updated outstanding balance
If the invoice is now fully paid, the seller is told no reminder is needed
error_handling: If the seller has manually edited the draft and the balance changed, the seller is warned before the balance figure is replaced

validation_rules.description: The reminder draft text must not be empty or only whitespace before it can be saved or copied.
validation_rules.error_message: The reminder message cannot be empty. Add some text before saving or copying.

validation_rules.description: The reminder draft text is limited to 1000 characters so it stays readable in a WhatsApp message on a mobile screen.
validation_rules.error_message: The reminder message is too long. Keep it under 1000 characters.

steps.description: Seller copies the draft or opens a WhatsApp draft to the customer's phone; the seller sends it manually.

business_rules.name: copying_or_opening_draft_does_not_mark_reminder_sent
business_rules.description: Copying a reminder draft or opening a WhatsApp draft leaves the reminder unsent, and only a seller-recorded follow-up marks it as sent.
triggers: Seller clicks copy on the reminder draft
Seller opens the WhatsApp draft for the customer
side_effects: Reminder.status stays unsent
Reminder.sent_at is not set
No FollowUp record is created until the seller records a sent follow-up
error_handling: If the clipboard copy fails, the draft text stays on screen and the seller is told the copy did not work, with the reminder still unsent
If the WhatsApp draft cannot open, the seller is shown the copy option instead and the reminder remains unsent

missing: FollowUp.sent_at — no table for FollowUp

business_rules.name: whatsapp_draft_requires_customer_phone
business_rules.description: The WhatsApp draft option is offered only when the customer has a phone number on record; otherwise only copying the draft is available.
triggers: Reminder draft panel loads for an invoice whose customer is shown
Seller chooses the WhatsApp option
side_effects: WhatsApp draft option is shown or hidden based on Customer.phone
When the WhatsApp option is used, Reminder.channel is recorded as whatsapp
error_handling: If Customer.phone is empty, the WhatsApp option is hidden and a note tells the seller to add a phone number to the customer
If the stored phone number is malformed, the WhatsApp option is disabled and the seller can still copy the draft

business_rules.name: reminder_draft_uses_actual_invoice_details
business_rules.description: The reminder draft text is generated from the invoice number, due date, days overdue and customer name currently stored on the invoice and customer.
triggers: Reminder draft panel opens for an overdue invoice
Invoice or customer details change before the draft is copied or opened
side_effects: Reminder.message_body is regenerated from the current Invoice and Customer values
Seller sees the draft text with the invoice number, due date and customer name filled in
error_handling: If the invoice has no due date, the draft omits the due date line and the seller is told to check the text
If the customer record is missing, the panel shows an error and no draft is generated

missing: Reminder.message_body — no column message_body on reminders

business_rules.name: reminder_draft_editable_and_seller_sends_manually
business_rules.description: The seller can edit the generated draft text before copying or opening it, and the system never sends the message itself.
triggers: Seller edits the draft text in the panel
Seller copies or opens the draft to send it manually
side_effects: Reminder.message_body stores the seller's edited text
No message is sent to the customer by the system
error_handling: If the edited draft is empty, copy and WhatsApp actions are disabled until text is entered
If the edited draft exceeds the allowed length, the seller is told to shorten it before copying

missing: Reminder.message_body — no column message_body on reminders

validation_rules.description: The reminder draft text must not be empty before it can be copied or opened.
validation_rules.error_message: Reminder message cannot be empty. Add some text before copying or opening WhatsApp.

missing: Reminder.message_body — no column message_body on reminders

validation_rules.description: The reminder draft text is limited to 1000 characters so it fits a WhatsApp message comfortably.
validation_rules.error_message: Reminder message is too long. Keep it under 1000 characters.

missing: Reminder.message_body — no column message_body on reminders

steps.description: Seller records that the follow-up was sent, updating the last-follow-up entry.

business_rules.name: follow_up_recorded_only_on_seller_confirmation
business_rules.description: A FollowUp is created as sent only when the seller explicitly records it, so opening or copying a reminder draft leaves no sent record (draft → copied or opened → recorded as sent).
triggers: Seller clicks the action to record that a follow-up was sent on InvoiceDetailPage
Seller opens or copies a reminder draft without recording a follow-up
side_effects: A FollowUp record is saved with status sent and the chosen sent_at date and channel
Opening or copying a reminder draft creates no FollowUp record and does not mark anything as sent
error_handling: If the seller opens or copies a draft and leaves the page, no FollowUp is saved
If saving the FollowUp fails, the seller sees an error and no partial follow-up is stored

missing: FollowUp.invoice_id — no table for FollowUp
FollowUp.status — no table for FollowUp
FollowUp.sent_at — no table for FollowUp
FollowUp.channel — no table for FollowUp

business_rules.name: recorded_follow_up_updates_last_follow_up_entry
business_rules.description: Recording a sent follow-up sets the invoice's last follow-up to that FollowUp's sent_at, replacing any earlier entry (sent → last follow-up shown in collections).
triggers: Seller records a sent follow-up on an overdue invoice
side_effects: The collections list and the invoice detail show the new sent_at as the last follow-up for that invoice
The most recent FollowUp for the invoice is treated as its last follow-up, with earlier follow-ups kept as history
error_handling: If the invoice has been fully paid or cancelled before the follow-up is saved, the seller is told the follow-up cannot be recorded against it

missing: FollowUp.sent_at — no table for FollowUp
FollowUp.invoice_id — no table for FollowUp

business_rules.name: follow_up_does_not_change_payment_dates_or_alerts_automatically
business_rules.description: Recording a follow-up changes no invoice due date, expected collection date, payment or customer contact automatically; only the FollowUp record is written.
triggers: Seller records a sent follow-up on an overdue invoice
side_effects: Invoice.due_date and Invoice.expected_collection_date stay unchanged
The overdue invoice alert is re-evaluated from the invoice's balance and dates, not from the follow-up itself
error_handling: No automatic date change occurs if the follow-up save fails

missing: FollowUp.invoice_id — no table for FollowUp

business_rules.name: follow_up_limited_to_unpaid_overdue_invoices
business_rules.description: A sent follow-up can be recorded only against an invoice that still has an outstanding balance and is overdue, while draft and cancelled invoices are excluded.
triggers: Seller opens the record-follow-up action on an invoice
side_effects: The record-follow-up action is shown only when the outstanding balance (invoice total minus recorded payments) is greater than zero and the invoice is overdue
Draft and cancelled invoices do not show the action
error_handling: If the invoice became fully paid after the page was loaded, the save is refused and the seller sees the current balance is zero

missing: FollowUp.invoice_id — no table for FollowUp

validation_rules.description: The date the follow-up was sent is required and interpreted on the Asia/Kolkata calendar.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the date the follow-up was sent.

validation_rules.error_message: The follow-up date cannot be in the future.

validation_rules.description: The channel used to send the follow-up must be chosen from the available options (WhatsApp or other).
validation_rules.error_message: Choose how the follow-up was sent.

name: Set Expected Collection Date for Overdue Invoice
description: The seller schedules an expected collection date for an overdue invoice so it enters the dated forecast.

steps.description: Seller sees overdue invoices marked unscheduled on collections.

business_rules.name: invoice_is_overdue_only_when_balance_remains_after_due_date
business_rules.description: An invoice is overdue when it has an unpaid balance remaining after its due date (evaluated on the Asia/Kolkata calendar), while draft and cancelled invoices are never treated as overdue or receivable.
triggers: Seller opens the collections page
Calendar date passes an invoice's due date with an outstanding balance
A payment is recorded or an invoice is cancelled, changing its outstanding balance
side_effects: Invoice.status is shown as overdue (unpaid balance remaining after due date) on the collections page
Draft and cancelled invoices are excluded from overdue receivables and from the collections list
error_handling: If the outstanding balance is zero, the invoice is not overdue even if the due date has passed
If Invoice.due_date is missing, the invoice cannot be classified as overdue and is not listed as unscheduled

business_rules.name: overdue_invoice_without_expected_date_is_unscheduled
business_rules.description: An overdue invoice with no expected collection date is shown as unscheduled on the collections page and is left out of the dated cash forecast until the seller sets one.
triggers: Seller opens the collections page
An invoice becomes overdue with no Invoice.expected_collection_date set
side_effects: The invoice appears in a separate unscheduled section of the collections page, not among dated collections
The invoice's outstanding balance is excluded from the 30, 60 and 90-day dated forecast
error_handling: If the invoice has no outstanding balance, it is not shown as unscheduled
If the seller sets an expected collection date, the invoice moves out of the unscheduled section and into dated collections

business_rules.name: unscheduled_overdue_invoice_raises_set_expected_date_alert
business_rules.description: Each overdue invoice without an expected collection date has an alert linked to that invoice that prompts the seller to set an expected date, and the alert resolves when the date is set or the balance reaches zero.
triggers: An invoice becomes overdue with no Invoice.expected_collection_date
Seller sets or clears Invoice.expected_collection_date
A payment reduces the outstanding balance to zero
side_effects: An Alert is created or kept open for the invoice with the message to set an expected date
The Alert is resolved when Invoice.expected_collection_date is set or the invoice is fully paid
No customer is contacted and no payment date is changed automatically
error_handling: If the underlying invoice is deleted or cancelled, the linked Alert is resolved rather than left pointing at a removed record
Duplicate alerts for the same invoice and type are not created

missing: Alert.invoice_id — no column invoice_id on alerts
Alert.type — no column type on alerts

business_rules.name: unscheduled_invoices_prioritised_by_outstanding_and_days_overdue
business_rules.description: Unscheduled overdue invoices are ordered by outstanding amount and days overdue so the largest and oldest debts appear first, even when several customers are late at once.
triggers: Seller opens the collections page
Seller changes the sort order on the collections list
side_effects: The unscheduled list displays customer, invoice number, outstanding amount, due date and days overdue in priority order
error_handling: If two invoices have equal outstanding amounts, the one with more days overdue is listed first
If there are no unscheduled invoices, the section shows an empty state instead of a list

steps.description: Seller sets an expected collection date on the invoice.

business_rules.name: expected_collection_date_only_for_overdue_unpaid_invoices
business_rules.description: The seller can set an expected collection date only on an invoice that is overdue, meaning its due date has passed in Asia/Kolkata time and an outstanding balance remains.
triggers: Seller opens an overdue invoice on the Invoice Detail page and chooses to set an expected collection date
Seller opens an invoice that is not yet due or has no outstanding balance
side_effects: Invoice.expected_collection_date is saved on the invoice if the invoice qualifies
The date control is hidden or disabled for invoices that are draft, cancelled, paid, not yet due, or fully settled
error_handling: If the invoice is not overdue or has no outstanding balance, the save is refused and the seller sees a message explaining why a date cannot be set
If the invoice is draft or cancelled, the date is not offered and the invoice stays out of receivables and forecasts

business_rules.name: expected_collection_date_starts_at_due_date_and_is_editable
business_rules.description: The expected collection date starts at the invoice due date when no date has been set, and the seller can change it to any valid later date without altering the due date.
triggers: Seller views an overdue invoice that has no expected collection date
Seller edits and saves the expected collection date
side_effects: Invoice.expected_collection_date shows the due date as its default value until the seller changes it
Invoice.due_date is never changed by this action
The dated cash forecast uses the saved expected collection date for this invoice's outstanding balance
error_handling: If the seller clears the date, the invoice returns to unscheduled and is removed from the dated forecast
If the saved date is invalid, the previous value is kept and the seller is asked to correct it

business_rules.name: unscheduled_overdue_invoice_excluded_from_dated_forecast
business_rules.description: An overdue invoice with no expected collection date is shown as unscheduled and its outstanding balance is left out of the dated 30, 60 and 90-day forecasts until a date is set.
triggers: Forecast is calculated for any period
Overdue invoice has no expected collection date saved
side_effects: The invoice appears in the unscheduled section of the forecast with its outstanding balance
Once a date is saved, the outstanding balance is counted in the forecast period containing that date
A collection dated beyond the selected period is not counted within that period
error_handling: If the outstanding balance changes through a recorded payment, the forecast recalculates from the new balance

business_rules.name: outstanding_balance_is_total_minus_recorded_payments
business_rules.description: The amount used for expected collection is the invoice total minus the sum of recorded payments, shown identically wherever it appears.
triggers: Seller saves an expected collection date
A payment is recorded or changed on the invoice
side_effects: Invoice.status shows unpaid, partially paid, or paid based on the remaining balance
Forecast collection amount for this invoice equals the current outstanding balance
error_handling: If recorded payments exceed the invoice total, the overpayment is blocked before it is saved

business_rules.name: expected_date_change_does_not_change_payment_or_contact_customer
business_rules.description: Saving an expected collection date changes only that date and updates related alerts, without contacting the customer, marking a follow-up as sent, or altering any payment record.
triggers: Seller saves an expected collection date on an overdue invoice
side_effects: The alert for overdue invoice without expected collection date is resolved for this invoice
No Payment records are created or changed
No reminder or message is sent to the customer
error_handling: If the alert update fails, the expected collection date is still saved and the alert is refreshed on next view

business_rules.name: expected_collection_date_alert_resolves_when_date_set
business_rules.description: The alert for an overdue invoice without an expected collection date is resolved once a date is saved, and reappears if the date is cleared while the invoice is still overdue with a balance.
triggers: Seller saves an expected collection date
Seller clears the expected collection date on an overdue invoice
side_effects: Alert.status changes to resolved when a date is saved
Alert.status returns to open when the date is cleared on an overdue unpaid invoice
Alert disappears entirely when the invoice is fully paid
error_handling: If the alert does not match the current invoice state, it is recalculated from the invoice record on the next load

business_rules.name: expected_collection_date_must_be_today_or_later
business_rules.description: The expected collection date must be today or a future date in the Asia/Kolkata calendar, since a collection cannot be expected on a date already passed.
triggers: Seller enters or edits the expected collection date
side_effects: A valid date is saved to Invoice.expected_collection_date
An invalid date is rejected and nothing is saved
error_handling: If the entered date is before today in Asia/Kolkata, the save is blocked and the seller is asked to choose today or a later date

validation_rules.description: An expected collection date must be provided when the seller chooses to save a scheduled date.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose an expected collection date to save.

validation_rules.description: The expected collection date must be a valid calendar date in the Asia/Kolkata calendar.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid date, for example 15 Jun 2025.

validation_rules.description: The expected collection date must be today or later in Asia/Kolkata time.
validation_rules.error_message: Expected collection date cannot be before today.

steps.description: Seller opens cash forecast and sees the invoice now counted on its expected date, with the unscheduled alert resolved.

business_rules.name: overdue_invoice_without_expected_date_is_unscheduled
business_rules.description: An overdue invoice with an unpaid balance and no expected collection date is shown as unscheduled and is left out of the dated 30-, 60- and 90-day forecast totals.
triggers: Seller opens the cash forecast page
Forecast is recalculated after a payment or invoice change
side_effects: The invoice appears in a separate unscheduled section with its outstanding balance
The invoice's outstanding balance is excluded from every dated forecast horizon
error_handling: If the outstanding balance is zero, the invoice is not shown as unscheduled
If the invoice is draft or cancelled, it is not shown as unscheduled

business_rules.name: expected_collection_date_places_outstanding_balance_in_forecast
business_rules.description: Once an expected collection date is set, the invoice's outstanding balance (total minus recorded payments) is counted in the forecast on that date, and only when that date falls within the selected 30-, 60- or 90-day period.
triggers: Seller sets Invoice.expected_collection_date on an overdue invoice
Seller opens the cash forecast after an expected date has been set
side_effects: The outstanding balance appears as an expected collection on the set date in the forecast chart and breakdown
The invoice no longer appears in the unscheduled section
The invoice is counted in a 30-, 60- or 90-day forecast only if its expected date is within that period
error_handling: If the expected date is beyond the selected period, the balance is not counted in that period's totals
If the invoice is fully paid before the expected date, its balance is zero and nothing is counted

business_rules.name: unscheduled_overdue_alert_resolves_when_expected_date_set
business_rules.description: The overdue-invoice-without-expected-date alert moves from open to resolved when the invoice's expected collection date is set, without changing the due date or contacting the customer.
triggers: Seller sets Invoice.expected_collection_date on an overdue invoice
Forecast page refreshes after the expected date is saved
side_effects: Alert.status becomes resolved and Alert.resolved_at is recorded
The alert no longer appears on the Today screen
Invoice.due_date is not changed
No reminder or message is sent to the customer
error_handling: If the expected date is cleared again, the alert reopens as open
If the invoice is paid in full, the alert resolves regardless of whether an expected date was set

missing: Alert.invoice_id — no column invoice_id on alerts

business_rules.name: forecast_excludes_draft_cancelled_and_paid_invoices
business_rules.description: Draft and cancelled invoices, and invoices with zero outstanding balance, are excluded from unscheduled items and from all expected collections in the forecast.
triggers: Seller opens the cash forecast page
Invoice status changes to draft, cancelled or paid
side_effects: Draft and cancelled invoices do not appear in the forecast or unscheduled section
Paid invoices are not counted again as future collections
error_handling: If a paid invoice still has a recorded expected date, it is ignored in the forecast

business_rules.name: outstanding_balance_is_total_minus_payments
business_rules.description: The outstanding balance used in the forecast is Invoice.total minus the sum of Payment.amount recorded against that invoice, shown the same way everywhere.
triggers: Seller opens the cash forecast page
A payment is recorded against an invoice
side_effects: The forecast collection amount for the invoice equals the outstanding balance
Invoice.status updates to partially paid or paid when the balance changes
error_handling: If recorded payments exceed the total, the outstanding balance is treated as zero and the overpayment is blocked at entry

name: Add, Review and Pay an Upcoming Bill
description: The seller adds a supplier or running bill, reviews upcoming and overdue bills, and marks it paid.

steps.description: Seller opens expenses and sees bills by category and due date, with overdue bills flagged.

business_rules.name: unpaid_expense_past_due_is_overdue
business_rules.description: An expense with no payment recorded whose due date is before today (Asia/Kolkata) is flagged as overdue, and a bill with a due date today or later stays upcoming.
triggers: Seller opens the Expenses page
The date changes past an expense's due date while the bill is unpaid
side_effects: The expense is displayed with an overdue flag on the Expenses page
The overdue bill is counted in the overdue group, not the upcoming group
error_handling: If the due date is missing, the expense cannot be classed as overdue or upcoming and is listed under a 'no due date' group for the seller to correct
If a bill is recorded as paid, it is never flagged as overdue regardless of its due date

business_rules.name: expenses_grouped_by_category_and_sorted_by_due_date
business_rules.description: Unpaid expenses are grouped by category (blank T-shirts, printing, yarn, packaging, delivery, other) and ordered by due date, earliest first, with overdue bills shown first within their category.
triggers: Seller opens the Expenses page
An expense is added, edited, or marked paid
side_effects: The Expenses page shows one section per category with its bills listed by due date
Paid bills move out of the unpaid list into the paid history
error_handling: If a category is missing or not one of the six allowed values, the expense is shown under 'other' and flagged for correction
If no expenses exist, the page shows an empty state inviting the seller to add an upcoming bill

business_rules.name: overdue_unpaid_bills_are_cash_outflows_today
business_rules.description: Each overdue unpaid expense is treated as an outflow on today's date in the cash forecast until the seller sets a revised expected payment date, and this assumption is disclosed on the Expenses page.
triggers: Seller views the Expenses page with overdue bills present
Cash forecast is calculated
side_effects: Overdue unpaid bill amounts reduce projected available cash from today in the forecast
A note on the Expenses page explains that overdue bills are counted as today's outflow until a revised payment date is set
error_handling: If the seller has not set a revised payment date, the bill stays as today's outflow and the disclosure remains visible
If the bill is recorded as paid, it is removed from the outflows and not counted again

business_rules.name: paid_expenses_excluded_from_future_outflows
business_rules.description: An expense with a recorded payment date (paid_at) is marked paid, leaves the unpaid list, and is never counted again as a future outflow.
triggers: Seller records that a bill was paid
Seller opens the Expenses page after a bill has been paid
side_effects: The expense appears in the paid history on the Expenses page
The expense is excluded from upcoming and overdue groups and from forecast outflows
error_handling: If a paid_at date exists without an amount, the expense is shown as incomplete and excluded from totals until corrected

steps.description: Seller adds a bill with description, category, amount and due date.

business_rules.name: new_bill_must_have_a_listed_category
business_rules.description: A bill must be assigned one of the six categories (blank T-shirts, printing, yarn, packaging, delivery, other) before it is saved.
triggers: Seller submits the New Expense form with a category selected
side_effects: Expense.category is stored on the new bill
The bill appears under its category on the Expenses list
error_handling: If no category is selected, the bill is not saved and the seller is asked to choose a category
If a category outside the six allowed values is submitted, the bill is rejected and no Expense record is created

business_rules.name: bill_amount_must_be_a_positive_rupee_amount
business_rules.description: A bill's amount must be a positive rupee value so that it can be counted as an upcoming outflow in the cash forecast.
triggers: Seller enters an amount and submits the New Expense form
side_effects: Expense.amount is stored as the total owed for the bill
The amount is later used as an outflow in the 30-, 60- and 90-day cash forecasts
error_handling: A zero, negative or non-numeric amount is rejected and the bill is not saved
An amount with more than two decimal places is rejected until corrected

business_rules.name: new_bill_starts_as_unpaid
business_rules.description: A newly added bill starts with the status unpaid and no paid date, and moves to paid only when the seller records the payment (unpaid → paid).
triggers: Seller saves a new bill
side_effects: Expense.status is set to unpaid
Expense.paid_at stays empty
The bill is counted as an upcoming unpaid expense in the forecast
error_handling: A bill cannot be saved with a status other than unpaid or with a paid date already filled in

business_rules.name: bill_due_date_determines_forecast_timing
business_rules.description: The due date of a new bill, interpreted on the Asia/Kolkata calendar, decides which forecast window the bill falls into, and a due date earlier than today marks the bill as overdue immediately.
triggers: Seller saves a bill with a due date
The current date passes a bill's due date without the bill being paid
side_effects: The bill is placed in the 30-, 60- or 90-day forecast according to its due date
If the due date is before today, the bill is flagged as overdue and shown for immediate attention
An alert to review the bill is created for an upcoming or overdue supplier bill
error_handling: A missing due date prevents saving the bill
A bill due in the past is still saved, and is shown as overdue with the assumption that its outflow is counted today until the seller sets a revised payment date

business_rules.name: adding_bill_does_not_change_available_cash
business_rules.description: Saving a bill only records a planned expense and does not reduce the available cash until the bill is marked paid.
triggers: Seller saves a new bill
side_effects: Available cash on the Cash Forecast is unchanged
The bill is shown as a planned expense separate from actual cash
error_handling: No cash balance change is recorded on save, and any attempt to change the balance from the bill form is ignored

missing: Settings.opening_cash_balance — no table for Settings

business_rules.name: bill_is_saved_only_on_valid_submission
business_rules.description: A bill is created only when description, category, amount and due date all pass validation in a single submission.
triggers: Seller presses save on the New Expense form
side_effects: On success, a new Expense record is created and the seller is taken to the bill's detail or the Expenses list
On failure, no Expense record is created and the entered values are kept on the form
error_handling: If any required field is missing or invalid, all field errors are shown together and nothing is saved
If the save fails for a system reason, an error state is shown and the seller can retry without losing the entered values

validation_rules.error_message: Please describe what this bill is for.

validation_rules.error_message: Please choose a category for this bill.

validation_rules.error_message: Enter an amount greater than ₹0 with no more than two decimal places.

validation_rules.error_message: Please enter a valid due date.

validation_rules.description: Due date must be entered in a recognised date format (for example DD/MM/YYYY or a date picker value).
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the due date as a date, for example 15/07/2025.

steps.description: Seller opens the bill, reviews its details and records when it was paid.

business_rules.name: bill_becomes_paid_when_paid_date_recorded
business_rules.description: An upcoming bill moves from unpaid → paid when the seller records its paid date, and it is then removed from future outflows.
triggers: Seller enters a paid date on the bill and saves
side_effects: Expense.status becomes paid
Expense.paid_date is stored
the bill is no longer counted as an upcoming or overdue outflow in the cash forecast
any open upcoming-bill or overdue-bill Alert linked to this Expense is resolved
error_handling: If the paid date is missing, the bill stays unpaid and the seller is asked to enter a date
If the paid date is in the future relative to Asia/Kolkata today, the save is rejected and the bill stays unpaid

business_rules.name: paid_bill_recorded_as_seller_recorded_actual_payment
business_rules.description: A bill recorded as paid counts as an actual outflow on its paid date, labelled as seller-recorded rather than bank-verified, and only paid dates on or after the opening cash balance effective date affect available cash.
triggers: Seller records a paid date on a bill
side_effects: the paid amount is deducted from derived available cash on the paid date
the bill is shown as seller-recorded, not bank-verified
error_handling: If the paid date is before the opening balance effective date, the bill is marked paid but excluded from available cash and the seller sees a note explaining why

business_rules.name: overdue_unpaid_bill_treated_as_outflow_today
business_rules.description: An unpaid bill whose due date has passed (Asia/Kolkata) is flagged overdue and treated as an outflow today (unpaid → overdue) until the seller sets a revised expected payment date.
triggers: Asia/Kolkata calendar date passes the Expense.due_date while Expense.status is unpaid
Seller opens the bill and sees it flagged
side_effects: Expense.status shows overdue
the bill amount is counted as an outflow in the earliest forecast period
a bill Alert is raised for immediate attention, explaining the forecast treatment
error_handling: If Expense.expected_payment_date is set, the bill is treated as outflow on that revised date instead of today
A bill already paid is never flagged overdue

missing: Expense.expected_payment_date — no column expected_payment_date on expenses

business_rules.name: revised_payment_date_replaces_overdue_outflow_timing
business_rules.description: The seller may explicitly set a revised expected payment date on an overdue bill, which moves its forecast outflow to that date without changing the due date.
triggers: Seller enters a revised expected payment date on an overdue bill and saves
side_effects: Expense.expected_payment_date is stored
the forecast outflow moves to the revised date
the overdue bill Alert is updated to show the revised date
error_handling: If the revised date is before today (Asia/Kolkata), the save is rejected
The Expense.due_date is never changed automatically

missing: Expense.expected_payment_date — no column expected_payment_date on expenses

business_rules.name: bill_edits_do_not_alter_recorded_payment
business_rules.description: Editing a bill's description, category, amount or due date keeps an already recorded paid date and status unchanged unless the seller explicitly clears the paid date.
triggers: Seller edits fields of a paid or unpaid bill and saves
side_effects: the forecast and cash derivation recalculate from the saved amount and dates
Alert records linked to the bill are updated to match the new details
error_handling: If the new amount is zero or negative, the save is rejected and the previous values remain
Clearing paid date reverts status to unpaid or overdue based on the due date

validation_rules.description: A paid date must be entered to mark the bill as paid.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the date this bill was paid.

validation_rules.description: The paid date cannot be in the future relative to the Asia/Kolkata calendar date.
validation_rules.error_message: The paid date cannot be in the future.

validation_rules.description: A revised expected payment date must be today or later in the Asia/Kolkata calendar.
validation_rules.error_message: The expected payment date must be today or a later date.

missing: Expense.expected_payment_date — no column expected_payment_date on expenses

validation_rules.error_message: Enter an amount greater than ₹0.

validation_rules.description: A due date is required for every bill.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the bill's due date.

validation_rules.description: Category must be one of blank T-shirts, printing, yarn, packaging, delivery or other.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose a bill category.
