validation_rules.error_message: Enter a short description of the bill.

name: Review 30, 60 and 90-Day Cash Forecast
description: The seller reviews the cash projection, first shortage and assumptions, including what is estimated.

steps.description: Seller opens cash forecast and sees current available cash based on opening balance and entered records.

business_rules.name: available_cash_is_opening_balance_plus_later_actual_movements
business_rules.description: Available cash equals the OpeningBalance.amount plus Payment amounts received and Expense amounts paid dated on or after OpeningBalance.effective_date, and is labelled as based on entered records.
triggers: Seller opens the Cash Forecast page
Seller returns to the Cash Forecast page after recording a payment or marking a bill paid
side_effects: The page shows current available cash with a label stating it is based on entered records
No records are changed by viewing the balance
error_handling: No OpeningBalance exists: show an empty state prompting the seller to set an opening cash balance in Settings, and do not display a computed available cash figure
A Payment or Expense dated before OpeningBalance.effective_date exists: exclude it from the calculation so transactions already included in the opening balance are not counted again
Calculation cannot complete due to a data read failure: show an error state with a retry option and no partial balance

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: paid_bills_not_counted_as_future_outflows
business_rules.description: An Expense with a recorded paid_at date is treated as an actual outflow in available cash and is never counted again as an upcoming unpaid expense.
triggers: Seller opens the Cash Forecast page
Seller records that a bill was paid
side_effects: The paid bill reduces available cash once, on its paid date
The paid bill is excluded from the upcoming unpaid expenses shown in the forecast
error_handling: A paid bill has a paid_at date before OpeningBalance.effective_date: do not reduce available cash, because the opening balance already includes it
A bill has paid_at set but a blank amount: exclude it from the calculation and flag the record for correction

business_rules.name: overdue_unpaid_bills_treated_as_outflows_today
business_rules.description: An Expense with no paid_at date and a due_date before today (Asia/Kolkata) is treated as an outflow today until the seller sets a revised expected payment date, and this assumption is disclosed on the page.
triggers: Seller opens the Cash Forecast page on a day after an unpaid bill's due date
side_effects: The overdue bill is subtracted from available cash as a today outflow in the forecast
The bill is flagged for immediate attention, with a note explaining it is treated as due today
No due_date is changed automatically
error_handling: Seller has set a revised expected payment date on the Expense: use that date for the forecast instead of treating the bill as due today
Due date is missing on an unpaid Expense: treat it as not dated and list it separately rather than assuming today

business_rules.name: draft_and_cancelled_invoices_excluded_from_cash
business_rules.description: Only Payment records against Invoice records that are not draft or cancelled count toward actual cash; creating an invoice never increases available cash.
triggers: Seller opens the Cash Forecast page
Seller creates a new invoice or cancels an existing one
side_effects: Available cash reflects only Payments that were actually recorded against active invoices
Draft and cancelled invoice totals are kept out of receivables and forecast figures
error_handling: Payment recorded against a cancelled invoice: exclude it from available cash and flag the inconsistency for the seller to review
Invoice status is unreadable: exclude its Payments and show a data warning instead of guessing

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: seller_recorded_payments_labelled_not_bank_verified
business_rules.description: Every Payment included in available cash is labelled as seller-recorded and not bank-verified on the Cash Forecast page.
triggers: Seller opens the Cash Forecast page with at least one Payment in the calculation
side_effects: The breakdown shows a note that payments are seller-recorded and not bank-verified
The payment method is shown next to each included Payment in the breakdown
error_handling: Payment has no payment_method: still include it, show the method as not recorded, and keep the seller-recorded label
No Payments exist in the period: show the seller-recorded note only in the assumptions section

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: forecast_figures_use_rupee_and_kolkata_dates
business_rules.description: All available cash amounts are formatted in Indian rupees and all date comparisons for effective dates, due dates and paid dates use the Asia/Kolkata calendar.
triggers: Seller opens the Cash Forecast page
side_effects: Available cash is displayed in rupee format
Overdue and effective-date comparisons are made against the Asia/Kolkata date
error_handling: Date stored without timezone information: interpret it as an Asia/Kolkata calendar date before comparing

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

steps.description: Seller switches between 30, 60 and 90-day views and sees the chart and breakdown of collections and bills.

business_rules.name: forecast_window_counts_only_dated_collections_within_period
business_rules.description: For the selected 30-, 60- or 90-day view, an invoice's outstanding balance is counted as a collection only when its expected collection date falls within the window from today (Asia/Kolkata) to the end of that period.
triggers: Seller switches the forecast view to 30, 60 or 90 days
Seller edits an invoice's expected collection date and the forecast recalculates
side_effects: The chart and collections breakdown show only invoices whose expected collection date is inside the selected window
Invoices with an expected collection date after the window end are excluded from that view but remain in the 60- or 90-day view when their date falls inside it
error_handling: If an invoice has no expected collection date and is not overdue, its expected collection date defaults to its due date before it is placed in the window
If an invoice is overdue and has no expected collection date, it is shown as unscheduled and is left out of all dated windows

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: only_outstanding_balance_of_active_invoices_is_forecast
business_rules.description: Each invoice contributes only its outstanding balance, calculated as total minus recorded payments, and only when its status is unpaid or partially paid; draft, cancelled and paid invoices contribute nothing.
triggers: Forecast view is loaded or switched
A payment is recorded against an invoice that changes its outstanding balance
side_effects: Fully paid invoices drop out of the collections breakdown so they are not counted again as future receipts
Draft and cancelled invoices never appear as collections
error_handling: If recorded payments equal or exceed the invoice total, the invoice contributes zero and is excluded from collections
If an invoice's status is draft or cancelled, it is excluded even when it has a due date inside the window

business_rules.name: unpaid_expenses_within_window_are_forecast_outflows
business_rules.description: Each unpaid expense bill is counted as an outflow in the window in which its expected payment date falls, using its due date as the default expected payment date, and paid bills are excluded.
triggers: Forecast view is loaded or switched
Seller records a bill as paid or changes a bill's due date or expected payment date
side_effects: Unpaid bills due within the selected period appear in the expenses breakdown and reduce the projected balance
Bills marked paid no longer appear as future outflows
error_handling: If a bill has no paid date and a due date beyond the window, it is excluded from that view and shown only in later windows
If a bill has a paid date, it is never counted as a future outflow regardless of its due date

missing: Expense.expected_payment_date — no column expected_payment_date on expenses

business_rules.name: overdue_unpaid_bills_are_outflows_today_until_revised
business_rules.description: An overdue unpaid bill is treated as an outflow on today's date until the seller explicitly sets a revised expected payment date, and the forecast discloses this assumption.
triggers: A bill's due date passes while it remains unpaid
Forecast view is loaded or switched
side_effects: The overdue bill is counted in the first day of every window and reduces the starting projected balance
The forecast assumptions panel states that overdue bills are treated as due today
A projected cash shortage alert is created or updated if the bill causes the balance to go negative
error_handling: Once the seller sets a revised expected payment date, the bill moves to that date and stops counting as due today
If the revised expected payment date is in the past, the bill is treated as due today again

missing: Expense.expected_payment_date — no column expected_payment_date on expenses

business_rules.name: projected_balance_derives_from_opening_balance_plus_actual_and_planned_cash
business_rules.description: Each window's projected balance equals the current available cash, derived from the opening balance and later recorded payments, plus dated invoice collections, minus dated unpaid bills, calculated deterministically from the same stored records.
triggers: Forecast view is loaded or switched
Any invoice payment, expense payment or opening balance changes
side_effects: The chart plots a daily or milestone balance line from the current available cash through the selected period
The breakdown shows current available cash, expected collections and upcoming unpaid expenses as separate totals
error_handling: If no opening balance has been set, the forecast is shown as incomplete and the seller is prompted to set one in Settings
Payments dated before the opening balance's effective date are not counted again

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments
Expense.expected_payment_date — no column expected_payment_date on expenses

business_rules.name: switching_period_recalculates_without_changing_records
business_rules.description: Switching between 30, 60 and 90-day views recalculates the forecast from the same stored records and never modifies invoices, bills, payments or the opening balance.
triggers: Seller selects the 30-day, 60-day or 90-day view
side_effects: The chart and breakdown update to the selected horizon
The first projected shortage date and amount are recalculated for that horizon
error_handling: If the forecast cannot be calculated, the previous view remains and an error message is shown without altering records

missing: Expense.expected_payment_date — no column expected_payment_date on expenses

business_rules.name: first_shortage_and_estimate_disclosure_shown_for_each_view
business_rules.description: For each selected view, the first date on which the projected balance falls below zero is shown with its amount, and a note states that expected collections are estimates and that overdue bills are treated as due today.
triggers: Forecast view is loaded or switched and the projected balance goes negative
side_effects: The shortage date and amount are displayed prominently in the breakdown
A projected cash shortage Alert linked to the affected bills and collections is created or updated
error_handling: If no shortage occurs within the selected window, the view states that no shortage is projected and still shows the estimate note
If the shortage alert cannot be saved, the forecast still displays and the alert is retried on the next load

missing: Expense.expected_payment_date — no column expected_payment_date on expenses
Alert.type — no column type on alerts

steps.description: Seller reads the first projected shortage date and amount, and the assumptions note that collections are estimates.

business_rules.name: shortage_alert_shows_first_projected_shortage
business_rules.description: When the baseline cash forecast shows available cash falling below zero on any day within 30, 60 or 90 days, the linked Alert records the first such date and the projected shortage amount for the seller to read.
triggers: Seller opens the Cash Forecast page and the baseline forecast is computed
A forecast input record changes (Invoice, Expense, Payment, OpeningBalance) and the projection is recalculated
Seller opens the Today page and the projected shortage alert is listed
side_effects: Alert.shortage_date is set to the earliest day the baseline available cash goes below zero
Alert.shortage_amount is set to the most negative projected balance on that first shortage day, shown in Indian rupee format
Alert.status is set to open while a shortage exists
The seller sees the first shortage date and amount on the Cash Forecast page and the Today page
error_handling: No projected day falls below zero: no shortage alert is shown, and any existing open shortage alert is resolved
Forecast cannot be calculated because source records fail to load: the alert is not shown as current and an error state is displayed instead of a stale shortage figure
Forecast inputs are empty (no OpeningBalance, Invoice or Expense records): the alert shows a missing-data state rather than a shortage amount

business_rules.name: forecast_assumptions_note_disclosed_with_alert
business_rules.description: The shortage alert is always shown with an assumptions note stating that expected collections are estimates and that overdue unpaid bills are treated as outflows today until a revised payment date is set.
triggers: Seller views a projected shortage alert on the Cash Forecast page
Seller views a projected shortage alert on the Today page
side_effects: Alert.message includes the note that expected collections are estimates
Alert.message states that overdue unpaid bills are counted as outflows today until the seller sets a revised expected payment date
The note appears alongside the first shortage date and amount, and is not hidden or collapsed
error_handling: Alert has no linked forecast: the note is still displayed with a message that no forecast is available
Overdue unpaid bills exist but none are scheduled: the note names them as treated as outflows today

business_rules.name: shortage_alert_uses_only_counted_records
business_rules.description: The shortage figure counts only the opening balance plus dated, unpaid, non-draft, non-cancelled invoice outstanding balances and unpaid bills, and excludes paid records, draft or cancelled invoices, and overdue invoices without an expected collection date.
triggers: Baseline forecast is recalculated for the shortage alert
A payment is recorded, an invoice is cancelled, or a bill is marked paid
side_effects: Paid invoices and paid bills are not counted again as future transactions in the shortage figure
Overdue invoices without an expected collection date are excluded from the dated projection, so they do not reduce the shortage
Transactions dated before OpeningBalance.effective_date are not counted a second time
Alert.shortage_date and Alert.shortage_amount change when these records change
error_handling: Invoice is draft or cancelled: it is excluded from collections and the shortage does not include it
Invoice collection date is after the 90-day window: it does not reduce the shortage within the period

missing: Invoice.outstanding_balance — no column outstanding_balance on invoices

business_rules.name: shortage_alert_excludes_what_if_scenarios
business_rules.description: The shortage alert shown on this step reflects only the baseline forecast from saved records, and never reflects a what-if Scenario, which stays separate from business records.
triggers: Seller runs a what-if delay on an invoice on the Cash Forecast page
Seller resets a what-if scenario to the baseline
side_effects: Alert.shortage_date and Alert.shortage_amount remain the baseline values while a scenario is running
The scenario comparison is shown separately from the baseline alert
Resetting a scenario does not change Invoice.expected_collection_date or any other saved record
error_handling: Scenario is active: the baseline alert is still displayed, and the scenario result is labelled as what-if rather than actual

name: What-If Delay Scenario and Reset
description: The seller delays one invoice's collection to test a shortage, compares it to baseline, then resets without changing saved records.

steps.description: Seller opens cash forecast and selects an outstanding invoice to delay.

business_rules.name: scenario_delay_applies_only_to_outstanding_invoices
business_rules.description: Only invoices with an unpaid balance that are not draft or cancelled can be selected for a what-if delay, since only outstanding invoices feed receivables and forecasts.
triggers: Seller opens the cash forecast and opens the what-if panel
Seller opens the invoice selector in the scenario panel
side_effects: The selector lists only invoices with status unpaid, partially paid or overdue and an outstanding balance above zero
Draft, cancelled and fully paid invoices are not offered for selection
error_handling: If the seller tries to choose a paid, draft or cancelled invoice, the choice is rejected and the panel explains that only outstanding invoices can be delayed
If no outstanding invoices exist, the panel shows an empty state with a link back to the invoices list

business_rules.name: scenario_delay_shifts_expected_collection_date_in_scenario_only
business_rules.description: Delaying an invoice moves its expected collection date forward by the delay days (default 15) inside the scenario, starting from the invoice's expected collection date, or its due date if none is set, without changing any saved invoice.
triggers: Seller selects an outstanding invoice in the scenario panel
Seller edits the delay days and applies the scenario
side_effects: The forecast recalculates with the selected invoice's outstanding balance moved to the delayed date
Invoice.expected_collection_date is left unchanged
The customer is not contacted and no payment date is altered
error_handling: If the selected invoice has no expected collection date and is overdue, the scenario cannot place it on a date and the panel asks the seller to set an expected collection date first
If the recalculated date falls beyond the 90-day horizon, the collection is excluded from the 30, 60 and 90-day totals

business_rules.name: scenario_is_separate_from_business_records_and_reset_restores_baseline
business_rules.description: The scenario is stored as its own record, and resetting it discards the scenario so the forecast returns to the baseline built from saved records, leaving Invoice, Payment and Expense records untouched.
triggers: Seller clicks reset on the what-if scenario
Seller leaves the cash forecast or refreshes the page with a scenario active
side_effects: Scenario record is cleared or reset to baseline
The forecast shows baseline minimum cash, shortage dates and collections again
No Invoice, Payment or Expense record is created, changed or deleted
error_handling: If the reset fails to save, the panel keeps the scenario visible and shows an error with a retry option
If there is no active scenario, reset is disabled and shows that the forecast is already at baseline

business_rules.name: scenario_compares_baseline_and_delayed_forecast
business_rules.description: The scenario recalculates the forecast so that baseline and scenario balances, minimum cash and first shortage dates are shown side by side over the same period.
triggers: Seller applies a delay to an outstanding invoice
Seller changes the delay days
side_effects: The panel shows baseline balance, scenario balance, change in minimum cash and the shortage date and amount under each
If the scenario creates a new shortage, an alert is shown with a suggested action to review affected collections and bills
error_handling: If the forecast cannot be calculated, the panel shows an error state and keeps the baseline visible
If the balances do not change because the delayed collection falls outside the period, the panel states that the delay has no effect in the selected horizon

business_rules.name: scenario_excludes_unscheduled_overdue_invoices_from_dated_forecast
business_rules.description: An overdue invoice with no expected collection date is treated as unscheduled and left out of the dated forecast, so it cannot be delayed until a date is set.
triggers: Seller opens the what-if panel and the invoice list includes an overdue invoice without an expected collection date
side_effects: The invoice is shown in the panel as unscheduled with a prompt to set an expected collection date
The forecast does not count the invoice in any dated period
error_handling: If the seller tries to delay an unscheduled invoice, the action is blocked and the panel links to setting an expected collection date

validation_rules.description: An outstanding invoice must be selected before a what-if delay can be applied.
validation_rules.error_message: Select an outstanding invoice to delay.

validation_rules.description: Delay days is required and defaults to 15 when the scenario is opened.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the number of days to delay the collection.

validation_rules.description: Delay days must be a whole number of at least 1.
validation_rules.error_message: Delay must be a whole number of days, 1 or more.

steps.description: Seller sets a delay in days (default 15) and sees baseline and scenario compared, including the shortage and suggested action.

business_rules.name: scenario_delay_defaults_to_15_days
business_rules.description: The delay input starts at 15 days and the seller can change it before running the scenario.
triggers: Seller opens the what-if panel on the Cash Forecast page
Seller edits the delay days value
side_effects: Scenario.delay_days is set to 15 when no delay has been entered yet
The panel recalculates the scenario using the entered delay
error_handling: If no invoice is selected, the scenario is not run and the panel asks the seller to select an outstanding invoice
If the entered delay is invalid, the previous valid scenario result stays visible and the field shows the error

business_rules.name: scenario_delay_applies_only_to_scenario_not_business_records
business_rules.description: Running a delay changes only the Scenario record and never changes the invoice's expected collection date, payments or any other saved record.
triggers: Seller runs a what-if delay on a selected outstanding invoice
Seller resets the scenario to baseline
side_effects: Scenario.delay_days and Scenario.status are saved for the what-if
Invoice.expected_collection_date is left unchanged
Invoice.outstanding_amount is left unchanged
error_handling: If saving the scenario fails, the baseline forecast stays on screen and the seller sees a retry message without any business record being altered

business_rules.name: scenario_only_delays_outstanding_invoices
business_rules.description: Only invoices with an unpaid outstanding balance can be selected for a delay; paid, draft and cancelled invoices are excluded.
triggers: Seller selects an invoice in the what-if panel
side_effects: Only eligible invoices appear as choices in the scenario selector
error_handling: If an ineligible invoice is somehow submitted, the scenario is rejected and the seller is told the invoice is not outstanding

business_rules.name: scenario_compares_baseline_and_scenario_on_same_forecast
business_rules.description: The baseline and the delayed scenario are calculated over the same 30, 60 or 90 day window, and the panel shows the minimum cash and first shortage date and amount for each side by side.
triggers: Seller runs the what-if delay
Seller changes the forecast period
side_effects: Scenario.baseline_min_cash, Scenario.scenario_min_cash and the shortage dates and amounts are stored on the Scenario
The panel shows the changes to minimum cash and shortage dates
error_handling: If the opening cash balance is not set, the panel says the comparison needs an opening balance and does not show a shortage result
If no unpaid bills or collections fall within the period, the panel shows no shortage and says so

business_rules.name: delayed_collection_outside_horizon_is_excluded
business_rules.description: If the delayed expected collection date falls after the selected forecast period, that amount is not counted within the period in the scenario.
triggers: Seller runs a delay that moves the expected collection date beyond the 30, 60 or 90 day window
side_effects: The scenario balance within the window drops the delayed collection
The panel notes that the delayed collection falls outside the selected period
error_handling: If the delayed date is beyond the horizon, the panel shows the amount as moved outside the period rather than hiding it

business_rules.name: scenario_shortage_shows_suggested_action_without_creating_alert
business_rules.description: When the scenario causes a projected cash shortage, the panel shows a suggested action to review the delayed invoice and bills due before the shortage date, and the scenario does not create a saved Alert.
triggers: Scenario minimum cash falls below zero within the forecast period
side_effects: The panel shows the shortage amount, shortage date and suggested action
No Alert is created or changed by the scenario itself
error_handling: If no shortage is projected, the suggested action is replaced with a note that no action is needed in this scenario

business_rules.name: overdue_unpaid_bills_count_as_outflows_in_scenario
business_rules.description: Overdue unpaid bills are treated as outflows today in both the baseline and the scenario until the seller sets a revised expected payment date.
triggers: Scenario is calculated while overdue unpaid expenses exist
side_effects: Overdue unpaid bills reduce the balance from the start of both forecasts
The panel discloses this assumption
error_handling: If an overdue bill has no paid date and no revised date, it remains an outflow today and is flagged for attention

validation_rules.description: A delay in days must be entered before the scenario can run, and it defaults to 15.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter how many days to delay the collection.

validation_rules.description: The delay must be a whole number of days with no decimals or sign.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a whole number of days, such as 15.

validation_rules.description: The delay is between 1 and 90 days, matching the longest forecast period.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a delay between 1 and 90 days.

steps.description: Seller resets the scenario to baseline; saved invoices and payments remain unchanged.

business_rules.name: reset_scenario_restores_baseline_only
business_rules.description: Resetting a what-if scenario discards the scenario's delay and returns the forecast to the baseline (Scenario active → reset to baseline), without changing any saved invoice, payment, or bill.
triggers: Seller presses Reset on the what-if scenario on the Cash Forecast page
side_effects: Scenario.delay_days is cleared and Scenario.status becomes baseline
Scenario.invoice_id is cleared so no invoice is selected for delay
The forecast page shows the baseline 30-, 60- and 90-day projections, minimum cash and shortage dates again
Invoice.expected_collection_date, Invoice.due_date and Invoice.status are read to rebuild the baseline but are not written
error_handling: If the scenario cannot be cleared because the save fails, the seller sees an error message and the scenario keeps its previous delay so the screen stays consistent
If the scenario is already at baseline, Reset does nothing and shows no error
If the referenced invoice has been deleted or cancelled since the scenario was created, the scenario is still cleared and the baseline is shown without it

business_rules.name: saved_invoices_and_payments_unchanged_by_reset
business_rules.description: Reset must leave every saved Invoice and Payment record exactly as it was before the reset, including expected collection dates and recorded amounts.
triggers: Seller presses Reset on the what-if scenario on the Cash Forecast page
side_effects: No Invoice or Payment record is created, updated or deleted by the reset
Invoice.expected_collection_date keeps the date the seller set before the scenario was run
Alerts linked to those invoices are not re-opened or re-resolved by the reset
error_handling: If a reset attempt would change any saved invoice or payment, the change is rejected and the seller sees an error message
If a saved invoice was edited in another tab after the scenario started, the reset still returns the baseline using the latest saved values

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

name: Set Shop Details and Opening Cash Balance
description: The seller sets shop details and an opening cash balance with an effective date so earlier transactions are not counted twice.

steps.description: Seller opens settings and sees current shop details and opening balance.

business_rules.name: opening_balance_displayed_with_effective_date
business_rules.description: The settings page shows the current opening cash balance together with its effective date, so the seller can see which transactions are already included in it.
triggers: Seller opens the Settings page
side_effects: The page shows the opening balance amount in Indian rupee format and its effective date in Asia/Kolkata calendar dates
No records are changed by viewing the page
error_handling: If the opening balance cannot be loaded, the page shows an error state with a retry option and does not show a stale or zero balance as if it were current
If no opening balance has been set, the page shows an empty state prompting the seller to set one, and cash derivations are labelled as not yet based on an opening balance

business_rules.name: shop_details_scoped_to_seller
business_rules.description: The shop details shown on the settings page belong only to the signed-in seller and are never shown to other users or to the public demo.
triggers: Seller opens the Settings page
side_effects: The page displays only the Shop record linked to the signed-in User
Private shop details remain protected from the public demo, which uses only fictional data
error_handling: If no Shop record exists for the signed-in User, the page shows an empty state inviting the seller to add shop details
If the request is not authorised for the Shop record, the page shows an access error and displays no shop details

business_rules.name: transactions_before_effective_date_excluded_from_cash
business_rules.description: Payments and expenses dated before the opening balance effective date are treated as already included in the opening balance and are not counted again in available cash, while later ones are counted.
triggers: Seller opens the Settings page and the current opening balance is displayed
Available cash is derived from the opening balance plus later receipts and payments
side_effects: Available cash shown elsewhere uses the opening balance and only Payment and paid Expense records dated on or after the effective date
The settings page indicates the effective date that the derived cash figure starts from
error_handling: If a Payment or paid Expense has no date, it is excluded from the derivation and flagged for the seller to correct
If the effective date is later than today, the page states that the opening balance will apply from that date

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: amounts_and_dates_use_india_formatting
business_rules.description: The opening balance amount is shown in Indian rupee formatting and its effective date is shown on the Asia/Kolkata calendar.
triggers: Seller opens the Settings page
side_effects: The balance and date display consistently with the rest of the app
error_handling: If the amount is missing or not a number, the page shows the empty state rather than a formatted value

steps.description: Seller enters shop name and details and saves them.

business_rules.name: shop_details_are_single_record_per_seller
business_rules.description: The seller has exactly one Shop record, and saving shop details updates that record rather than creating another.
triggers: Seller saves the shop details form on the Settings page
side_effects: The existing Shop record is updated with the entered details
Shop.updated_at is set to the save time
The saved shop details are shown again on the Settings page after a refresh
error_handling: If a Shop record already exists, the save overwrites its details instead of creating a second one
If the save fails to persist, the entered details remain in the form and an error is shown so nothing is silently lost

business_rules.name: shop_save_does_not_change_business_records
business_rules.description: Saving shop details changes only the Shop record and leaves customers, invoices, payments, expenses, opening balance, alerts and scenarios untouched.
triggers: Seller saves shop details that change the name, phone, email or address
side_effects: Only the Shop record changes
Existing invoices, payments and the opening cash balance keep their values
No customer is contacted and no alert is created or resolved by this save
error_handling: If a change would alter any other record, the save is rejected and the seller is told that shop details were not saved

business_rules.name: shop_details_used_in_printed_invoices
business_rules.description: The saved shop name and contact details are the seller-facing identity shown on invoice previews, printouts and reminder drafts.
triggers: Seller previews or prints an invoice
Seller opens a reminder draft for an overdue invoice
side_effects: Invoice preview header shows the shop name and contact details
Reminder drafts sign off with the shop name
error_handling: If no shop name has been saved yet, invoice preview shows a prompt to complete shop details instead of a blank header

validation_rules.description: Shop name is required and cannot be blank or only spaces.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter your shop name.

validation_rules.description: Shop name is at most 80 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Shop name must be 80 characters or fewer.

validation_rules.description: Shop phone is optional, but if entered it must contain 10 digits, optionally prefixed with +91 or 0 and spaces or dashes.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid 10-digit phone number, for example 98765 43210.

validation_rules.description: Shop email is optional, but if entered it must be a valid email address.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, for example shop@example.com.

validation_rules.description: Shop address is optional and at most 200 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Address must be 200 characters or fewer.

steps.description: Seller enters opening cash amount with an effective date and saves; cash forecast recalculates from this date.

business_rules.name: opening_balance_sets_cash_starting_point
business_rules.description: The seller's entered opening cash amount, with its effective date, is the starting point from which available cash and the cash forecast are calculated.
triggers: Seller enters an opening cash amount and effective date in the OpeningBalanceForm and saves
side_effects: OpeningBalance.amount and OpeningBalance.effective_date are stored as the current opening balance
available cash and the 30-, 60- and 90-day cash forecasts are recalculated from the effective date
error_handling: If the amount or effective date is missing or invalid, the save is refused and the stored opening balance is left unchanged
If the save fails, the seller sees an error message and the previous opening balance remains in use

business_rules.name: transactions_before_effective_date_not_counted_again
business_rules.description: Payments and paid expenses dated before the opening balance's effective date are already reflected in the entered amount and must not be counted a second time.
triggers: Seller saves an opening balance with an effective date
Cash forecast or available cash is calculated
side_effects: only Payment records dated on or after OpeningBalance.effective_date are added to available cash
only Expense records paid on or after OpeningBalance.effective_date are deducted from available cash
Payment and Expense records themselves are not modified
error_handling: If no OpeningBalance exists, available cash is shown as not set and the seller is prompted to enter an opening balance
If a Payment or Expense has no date, it is excluded from the calculation and flagged for the seller to correct

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: opening_balance_change_does_not_alter_business_records
business_rules.description: Saving or changing the opening balance changes only the OpeningBalance record and never edits invoices, payments, customers or expenses.
triggers: Seller saves a changed opening balance amount or effective date
side_effects: only the OpeningBalance record is updated
forecast and available cash figures change to reflect the new starting point
existing invoices, payments and bills keep their recorded values
error_handling: If a related business record would be changed by the save, the save is rejected and the seller sees an error message

validation_rules.description: Opening cash amount is required before the balance can be saved.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your opening cash amount.

validation_rules.description: Opening cash amount must be zero or a positive rupee value.
validation_rules.error_message: Opening cash must be zero or more rupees.

validation_rules.description: Opening cash amount may have at most two decimal places, matching rupee and paise.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the amount in rupees with up to two decimal places, for example 8000 or 8000.50.

validation_rules.description: Effective date is required and is read as an Asia/Kolkata calendar date.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose the date your opening cash amount applies from.

name: Daily Today Check and Alert Actions
description: The seller opens Today each day to see who to chase, which bills are coming and cash alerts, and jumps to the linked record.

steps.description: Seller opens Today and sees customers to follow up with today.

business_rules.name: today_follow_up_list_includes_only_overdue_unpaid_invoices
business_rules.description: An invoice appears on the Today follow-up list only when its status is unpaid or partially paid, its outstanding balance (total minus recorded payments) is above zero, and its due date is before today in Asia/Kolkata.
triggers: Seller opens the Today page
A payment is recorded or an invoice is created, edited, or cancelled, and the Today list is reloaded
side_effects: Each qualifying invoice is shown on Today with its customer, outstanding balance, due date and days overdue
Invoices that are not yet due are left off the follow-up list and kept for the Invoices page
error_handling: If no invoice qualifies, the page shows an empty state saying no customers need follow-up today
If the invoice or payment data cannot be loaded, the page shows an error state with a retry option and does not show a partial list as complete

business_rules.name: draft_and_cancelled_invoices_excluded_from_follow_up
business_rules.description: Invoices with draft or cancelled status never appear on the Today follow-up list, regardless of due date or balance.
triggers: Seller opens the Today page
An invoice is saved as draft or cancelled
side_effects: Draft and cancelled invoices are not counted as receivables in the Today list
No reminder or follow-up prompt is generated for these invoices
error_handling: If an invoice's status is unrecognised, it is excluded from the list and flagged for review rather than shown as owed

business_rules.name: follow_up_list_priority_order
business_rules.description: Overdue invoices on the Today list are ordered by outstanding balance (highest first), with days overdue (longest first) as the tie-breaker.
triggers: Seller opens the Today page
Balances or due dates change so the ordering changes
side_effects: The highest-value and most overdue customers appear at the top of the Today list, including when several customers are late at once
error_handling: If two invoices have identical balance and days overdue, they are ordered by customer name so the list stays stable between refreshes

business_rules.name: days_overdue_calculated_in_kolkata_calendar
business_rules.description: Days overdue equals today's Asia/Kolkata calendar date minus the invoice due date, and is shown as zero or not shown when the invoice is not yet due.
triggers: Seller opens the Today page
The day rolls over at Asia/Kolkata midnight while the page is open
side_effects: Each follow-up entry shows the correct number of days overdue
error_handling: If the due date is missing, the invoice is treated as not overdue and is not added to the follow-up list, with a note to the seller to set a due date

business_rules.name: customer_balance_shown_consistently_on_follow_up
business_rules.description: The outstanding amount shown for each follow-up entry equals the invoice total minus all recorded payments on that invoice, using the same figure as the Invoices and Customer pages.
triggers: Seller opens the Today page
A payment is recorded against an invoice on the follow-up list
side_effects: The follow-up entry for an invoice drops off the Today list when its balance reaches zero
error_handling: If recorded payments exceed the invoice total, the balance is shown as zero and the overpayment is flagged for review instead of showing a negative amount owed

business_rules.name: follow_up_entry_shows_last_follow_up_without_marking_sent
business_rules.description: Each follow-up entry on Today shows the date of the most recent recorded follow-up for that invoice, and viewing the list never marks a follow-up as sent.
triggers: Seller opens the Today page
Seller opens a reminder draft from the Today list without sending it
side_effects: The last follow-up column shows the latest recorded sent date, or 'none yet' if none exists
No FollowUp record is created by viewing the Today page
error_handling: If the last follow-up cannot be loaded, the entry shows 'unknown' rather than 'none yet' so the seller is not misled

missing: FollowUp.sent_at — no table for FollowUp
FollowUp.invoice_id — no table for FollowUp

business_rules.name: overdue_invoice_alert_linked_to_follow_up_entry
business_rules.description: Each overdue unpaid invoice has one open overdue-invoice Alert shown on Today, which resolves automatically when the invoice balance reaches zero or the invoice is cancelled.
triggers: An invoice becomes overdue with a remaining balance
A payment clears the balance or the invoice is cancelled
side_effects: An overdue-invoice Alert is opened and linked to the invoice, offering to draft a reminder
The Alert is resolved and removed from Today once the invoice is fully paid or cancelled
No customer is contacted and no payment date is changed automatically
error_handling: If an invoice has an open Alert but no longer qualifies, the Alert is resolved rather than left showing stale information

missing: Alert.invoice_id — no column invoice_id on alerts

steps.description: Seller sees upcoming bills and cash alerts, each linked to its record.

business_rules.name: alert_links_to_source_record
business_rules.description: Every alert on the Today screen points to the single record it concerns (an Invoice, an Expense, or the forecast's affected collections and bills), so the seller can open that record directly.
triggers: Seller opens the Today screen
An invoice becomes overdue, a bill comes due, or a projected shortage appears
side_effects: Each Alert row shows its linked Invoice or Expense, and tapping it opens that record
Alerts with no linked record are not shown on the Today screen
error_handling: If the linked Invoice or Expense no longer exists, the Alert is marked resolved and is hidden rather than showing a broken link
If an alert's linked record cannot be loaded, the alert row shows a clear error state with a retry option

business_rules.name: overdue_unpaid_bill_flagged_for_immediate_attention
business_rules.description: An unpaid Expense whose due date (Asia/Kolkata) is before today, with no paid date and no revised payment date, is shown as an overdue bill needing immediate attention.
triggers: Today's date passes an unpaid bill's due date
Seller opens the Today screen
side_effects: An overdue bill alert is shown on the Today screen linked to the Expense
The overdue bill's amount is treated as an outflow today in the cash forecast until the seller sets a revised payment date
The Expense is labelled overdue in the bill list
error_handling: If Expense.paid_at is set, no overdue alert is created and any existing one is resolved
If Expense.revised_payment_date is set by the seller, the alert shows the revised date and the bill is no longer treated as due today

business_rules.name: upcoming_supplier_bill_alert
business_rules.description: An unpaid Expense with a due date on or after today (Asia/Kolkata) is listed as an upcoming bill with a review action, showing category, amount and due date.
triggers: A bill is added with a due date in the future
Seller opens the Today screen
side_effects: An upcoming bill alert appears on the Today screen with a review action linked to the Expense
The alert is removed when the bill is marked paid or deleted
error_handling: A bill with no due date is not shown as an upcoming bill alert
If the due date is changed to the past, the alert changes to overdue instead of upcoming

business_rules.name: overdue_invoice_alert_with_draft_reminder
business_rules.description: An Invoice that is not draft or cancelled, has an outstanding balance (Invoice.total minus recorded Payments) above zero, and whose due date (Asia/Kolkata) has passed, is shown as an overdue invoice alert with a draft reminder action.
triggers: Invoice due date passes with an unpaid balance remaining
A payment is recorded that does not clear the balance
Seller opens the Today screen
side_effects: An overdue invoice alert is shown on the Today screen with the customer name and outstanding balance
The reminder action opens the invoice's draft reminder; opening it does not mark a follow-up as sent
error_handling: Draft or cancelled invoices never create an overdue alert
Invoices with zero outstanding balance have their overdue alert resolved automatically

business_rules.name: overdue_invoice_without_expected_date_alert
business_rules.description: An overdue Invoice with an outstanding balance and no expected collection date is shown as an unscheduled alert asking the seller to set an expected date.
triggers: An invoice becomes overdue with no expected collection date set
Seller opens the Today screen
side_effects: A set-expected-date alert appears linked to the Invoice
The invoice is kept out of the dated cash forecast until an expected date is set
error_handling: Setting an expected collection date resolves this alert and moves the invoice into the dated forecast
The alert is never used to change the due date or contact the customer

business_rules.name: projected_cash_shortage_alert
business_rules.description: When the forecast shows a projected cash balance below zero on any day within the 30-, 60- or 90-day window, an alert shows the first shortage date and amount and links to the affected collections and bills.
triggers: Forecast recalculates after a payment, bill, invoice or opening balance change
A what-if scenario is run or reset
Seller opens the Today screen
side_effects: A cash shortage alert shows the first shortage date and amount
The alert offers a review action listing the invoices and bills that drive the shortage
Running a scenario can create a shortage alert labelled as scenario-only, without changing baseline records
error_handling: Baseline shortage alerts are never created from scenario results
If no shortage exists after recalculation, the shortage alert is resolved automatically
Forecast figures are labelled as estimates based on entered records

business_rules.name: alerts_update_or_resolve_without_customer_or_date_changes
business_rules.description: Alerts are recalculated from the current state of their linked records and move to resolved when the condition no longer holds, without sending any customer message or changing any payment or expected date.
triggers: A Payment, Invoice, Expense or Scenario record is created, edited or deleted
Seller records a payment, marks a bill paid, or sets an expected collection date
A reminder is opened or copied
side_effects: Alerts whose condition has cleared move to resolved and disappear from the Today screen
Alerts whose details have changed (amount, date, customer name) are updated in place
No customer is contacted and no due date or expected date is changed automatically
error_handling: Opening or copying a reminder does not resolve the overdue invoice alert, because the reminder has not been sent
If recalculation fails, existing alerts stay visible with a stale-data notice rather than disappearing silently

business_rules.name: alert_amounts_and_dates_in_rupees_and_kolkata_time
business_rules.description: Every alert amount is shown in Indian rupee formatting and every due-date comparison and days-overdue count uses the Asia/Kolkata calendar date.
triggers: Seller opens the Today screen
Date rolls over at midnight in Asia/Kolkata
side_effects: Days-overdue counts and due-today labels on alerts update at the Asia/Kolkata day boundary
Amounts display as rupee values consistent with other screens
error_handling: If the device timezone differs, the app still compares dates against the Asia/Kolkata calendar date

steps.description: Seller taps an alert such as 'Review bill' or 'Set expected date' and is taken to the linked record.

business_rules.name: alert_tap_opens_linked_record
business_rules.description: Tapping an alert opens the record it is linked to: an overdue invoice alert opens its Invoice, an upcoming supplier bill alert opens its Expense, and an overdue invoice with no expected collection date opens that Invoice to set the date.
triggers: Seller taps an alert in the alert list on the Today screen
side_effects: Seller is taken to the linked Invoice or Expense detail view
Alert.status is unchanged by the tap itself
error_handling: If the linked Invoice or Expense no longer exists, the alert is shown as no longer applicable and is resolved rather than opening an empty page
If the linked record is a draft or cancelled Invoice, the alert is not shown and the tap cannot open it from the alert list

business_rules.name: alert_tap_does_not_mark_action_complete
business_rules.description: Tapping an alert or opening a reminder draft from it does not mark a follow-up as sent, does not contact the customer, and does not change any payment date.
triggers: Seller taps an alert that leads to an overdue Invoice reminder
Seller opens a reminder draft from the linked Invoice
side_effects: Alert.status stays as it was until the underlying condition changes
No FollowUp is recorded as sent
No customer is contacted
Invoice.expected_collection_date is left unchanged
error_handling: If navigation fails, the alert remains open and unchanged and the seller sees an error message

missing: FollowUp.sent_at — no table for FollowUp

business_rules.name: alert_status_follows_underlying_records
business_rules.description: An alert moves from open to resolved, or updates its text, when the Invoice, Expense or cash forecast it refers to changes: open → resolved when the overdue balance reaches zero through recorded Payment entries, when an expected collection date is set, when an Expense is marked paid, or when the projected shortage no longer occurs.
triggers: Payment is recorded against an overdue Invoice
Invoice.expected_collection_date is set
Expense is marked paid
Cash forecast is recalculated after a record change
side_effects: Alert.status becomes resolved and the alert disappears from the open list
Alert.message is updated to reflect the current balance or shortage amount
error_handling: If a change cannot be matched to any open alert, no alert is created or resolved and the change is still saved

missing: Invoice.outstanding_balance — no column outstanding_balance on invoices

business_rules.name: cash_shortage_alert_links_to_affected_records
business_rules.description: A projected cash shortage alert links to the earliest affected Invoice or Expense, so the seller can review the collections and bills that cause the shortfall.
triggers: Seller taps a projected cash shortage alert
Cash forecast shows a first shortage date and amount
side_effects: Seller is taken to the Invoice or Expense that drives the shortage
Forecast figures are not changed by the tap
error_handling: If no single record drives the shortage, the alert opens the Cash Forecast view with the shortage date highlighted
If the shortage disappears on recalculation, the alert is resolved

steps.description: Seller opens the cash forecast from a shortage alert to review affected collections and bills.

business_rules.name: shortage_alert_opens_forecast_without_changing_records
business_rules.description: Opening the cash forecast from a projected cash shortage alert shows the forecast in read-only review and does not change any invoice, bill, payment, or opening balance.
triggers: Seller selects a projected cash shortage alert on the Today page
Seller opens the Cash Forecast page from a shortage alert
side_effects: Alert.status stays unchanged when the page is opened
No invoice, bill, payment, or opening balance record is modified
The forecast page shows the affected collections and bills that caused the shortage
error_handling: If the linked alert no longer exists or has been resolved, the page shows the current forecast with a note that the alert is no longer active
If no opening balance has been set, the page prompts the seller to set one in Settings and does not show a projected balance

business_rules.name: forecast_shows_first_shortage_date_and_amount
business_rules.description: The forecast identifies the first projected shortage date and the shortage amount, computed from current available cash plus dated collections minus unpaid expenses.
triggers: Cash Forecast page loads from a shortage alert
Forecast horizon is changed between 30, 60 and 90 days
side_effects: The first projected shortage date and amount are displayed prominently
The shortage shown in the alert matches the value on the forecast page
error_handling: If no shortage occurs within the selected horizon, the page states that no shortage is projected for that period
If records are incomplete, the page labels the figure as based on entered records

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: forecast_uses_only_unpaid_invoice_balances_on_expected_dates
business_rules.description: Expected collections use each unpaid invoice's outstanding balance (total minus recorded payments), dated by its expected collection date which starts at the due date, and draft or cancelled invoices are excluded.
triggers: Cash Forecast page loads
An invoice's expected collection date is edited
side_effects: Each collection appears on the forecast on its expected collection date
Paid invoices and draft or cancelled invoices do not appear as future collections
error_handling: If an invoice has no expected collection date and is not overdue, the due date is used
If an invoice's outstanding balance is zero, it is excluded from the forecast

business_rules.name: overdue_invoices_without_expected_date_are_unscheduled
business_rules.description: Overdue invoices with an unpaid balance and no expected collection date are shown separately as unscheduled and are left out of the dated forecast until the seller sets a date.
triggers: Cash Forecast page loads with overdue unpaid invoices
Seller has not yet set an expected collection date on an overdue invoice
side_effects: Unscheduled overdue balances are listed separately from the dated forecast
Unscheduled amounts do not change the projected balance or shortage date
error_handling: If the seller sets an expected collection date, the invoice moves from unscheduled into the dated forecast on that date
If the invoice is paid in full, it is removed from the unscheduled list

business_rules.name: overdue_unpaid_bills_are_outflows_today
business_rules.description: Overdue unpaid bills are treated as outflows on today's date until the seller explicitly sets a revised expected payment date, and this assumption is disclosed on the forecast.
triggers: Cash Forecast page loads with overdue unpaid bills
Seller sets a revised expected payment date on an overdue bill
side_effects: Overdue unpaid bills reduce the projected balance from today
The forecast displays a note stating that overdue bills are assumed to be paid today
Once a revised date is set, the bill moves to that date in the forecast
error_handling: If a bill is marked paid, it is removed from future outflows and not counted again
If the revised date is outside the selected horizon, the bill is not counted within that horizon

business_rules.name: paid_records_are_not_counted_again
business_rules.description: Invoices already fully paid and bills already marked paid are excluded from future transactions, and transactions included in the opening balance are not counted again.
triggers: Cash Forecast page loads
A bill is marked paid or an invoice receives its final payment
side_effects: Paid invoices and paid bills no longer appear as future collections or outflows
Actual receipts and payments after the opening balance's effective date are included once in available cash
error_handling: If a payment is dated before the opening balance's effective date, it is not added again to available cash
If a record is paid after the forecast was viewed, the forecast updates on next load

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: forecast_separates_actual_cash_from_planned_amounts
business_rules.description: The forecast presents available cash from the opening balance plus later actual receipts and payments separately from expected collections and planned expenses, labelled as based on entered records and expected collections as estimates.
triggers: Cash Forecast page loads
Seller reviews the forecast breakdown
side_effects: The breakdown lists current available cash, expected invoice collections, and upcoming unpaid expenses as separate lines
A note states that expected collections are estimates based on entered records
error_handling: If no payments have been recorded since the opening balance, the page states that available cash equals the opening balance

business_rules.name: scenario_stays_separate_from_business_records
business_rules.description: A what-if delay on one outstanding invoice is stored as a scenario that compares against the baseline, and resetting it restores the baseline without changing any saved invoice, payment, bill, or opening balance.
triggers: Seller opens the forecast and a scenario is already active
Seller selects Reset scenario
side_effects: Reset removes the scenario and the forecast returns to the baseline
No Invoice.expected_collection_date or other business record changes when the scenario is reset
error_handling: If the scenario's invoice has since been paid or cancelled, the scenario is cleared and the baseline is shown with a notice
If reset fails, the scenario remains active and an error message is shown

business_rules.name: shortage_alert_updates_when_underlying_records_change
business_rules.description: The projected cash shortage alert is resolved or updated when the invoices, bills, payments, or opening balance behind it change, and the forecast reflects the latest state.
triggers: An invoice payment, expected collection date, bill payment, or opening balance is changed
Cash Forecast page is reopened from an alert
side_effects: The shortage alert resolves when no shortage remains in the horizon
The alert amount and date update to match the current first shortage
error_handling: If the alert cannot be updated, the forecast still shows the correct current shortage and the alert is refreshed on next load

business_rules.name: forecast_uses_asia_kolkata_dates
business_rules.description: All forecast dates, due dates, and overdue calculations use the Asia/Kolkata calendar, and amounts are shown in Indian rupee format.
triggers: Cash Forecast page loads
Days overdue and forecast dates are calculated
side_effects: Forecast buckets for 30, 60 and 90 days start from the current Asia/Kolkata date
Amounts display in rupee format consistently across the forecast
error_handling: If a date is stored without a timezone, it is interpreted as an Asia/Kolkata calendar date

name: Find and Browse Customers
description: The seller searches saved customers and opens one to review invoices, payments and balance.

steps.description: Seller opens customers and searches by name, seeing outstanding balances.

business_rules.name: outstanding_balance_is_invoice_total_minus_payments
business_rules.description: Each customer's outstanding balance equals the sum of their invoice totals minus the sum of recorded payments on those invoices, and is shown the same way everywhere it appears.
triggers: Seller opens the Customers page
Seller searches for a customer by name
A payment is recorded or an invoice is created, changed or cancelled
side_effects: Each customer row on the Customers page shows the computed outstanding balance in Indian rupee formatting
The same outstanding figure is reused on Customer Detail, Invoices and Cash Forecast
error_handling: If a customer has no invoices, the balance shows ₹0 rather than blank
If recorded payments on an invoice would exceed its total, the overpayment is blocked at entry so the displayed balance never goes negative
If a balance cannot be computed because a related invoice or payment cannot be read, the row shows an error state instead of a misleading amount

business_rules.name: draft_and_cancelled_invoices_excluded_from_outstanding_balance
business_rules.description: Only invoices in unpaid, partially paid, or overdue status contribute to a customer's outstanding balance; draft and cancelled invoices are excluded (draft → unpaid → partially paid → paid, with cancelled as a terminal state).
triggers: Seller opens the Customers page
An invoice is saved as draft, issued, or cancelled
side_effects: Draft invoices do not add to any customer's outstanding balance
Cancelled invoices are removed from the customer's outstanding balance
Customer totals update when an invoice moves out of draft
error_handling: If an invoice status is missing or unrecognised, it is excluded from balances and flagged for review rather than counted
If a cancelled invoice has payments recorded against it, the balance excludes it and the payments are kept on the record

business_rules.name: customer_search_matches_name
business_rules.description: Searching the customers list returns the customers whose name contains the search text, ignoring letter case and surrounding spaces.
triggers: Seller types into the customer search field on the Customers page
Seller clears the search field
side_effects: The Customers list shows only matching customers with their outstanding balances
Clearing the search restores the full customer list
error_handling: If no customer matches, an empty-results state is shown with a prompt to add a new customer
If the search text is empty or only spaces, the full list is shown
If the customer list fails to load, an error state with a retry option is shown

business_rules.name: customer_overdue_indicator_uses_asia_kolkata_due_dates
business_rules.description: A customer is marked as having overdue money when any unpaid or partially paid invoice still has a balance after its due date, using the Asia/Kolkata calendar date, and overdue status is shown separately from the outstanding amount.
triggers: Seller opens the Customers page
Current date passes an invoice's due date with a balance still remaining
side_effects: The customer row shows an overdue label alongside the outstanding balance
Overdue customers are highlighted so the seller can prioritise follow-ups
error_handling: If an invoice has no due date, it is not treated as overdue and the row notes the missing date
If the overdue check cannot run, the balance still displays without the overdue label and a warning is shown

validation_rules.description: The customer search text may be up to 100 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Search is limited to 100 characters. Shorten your search to continue.

steps.description: Seller opens a customer and reviews their invoices, payment history and outstanding balance.

business_rules.name: customer_outstanding_balance_is_sum_of_open_invoice_balances
business_rules.description: A customer's outstanding balance equals the sum, across their receivable invoices, of each invoice total minus its recorded payments, and is shown the same way everywhere it appears.
triggers: Seller opens a customer's detail page
A payment is recorded against one of the customer's invoices
An invoice for the customer is created, edited, cancelled or marked draft
side_effects: The customer detail page shows the total outstanding balance in rupee format
The same outstanding figure appears on the Customers list and in collections views
error_handling: If a customer has no receivable invoices, the outstanding balance shows zero with an empty-state message rather than an error
If a payment total would exceed an invoice total, the balance is not shown as negative; the overpayment is prevented at entry and flagged if found in data

business_rules.name: draft_and_cancelled_invoices_excluded_from_receivables
business_rules.description: Invoices with status draft or cancelled are listed on the customer's history for reference but are excluded from outstanding balance, overdue status and forecasts (draft → unpaid → partially paid → paid, with cancelled as a terminal state).
triggers: Seller opens a customer's detail page with draft or cancelled invoices present
An invoice is saved as draft or cancelled
side_effects: Draft and cancelled invoices are labelled clearly and contribute zero to the customer's outstanding balance
Draft and cancelled invoices never appear in overdue lists or cash forecasts
error_handling: If a payment is found against a cancelled invoice, the balance is still excluded and the mismatch is surfaced to the seller for review instead of being silently counted

business_rules.name: invoice_status_and_overdue_derived_from_balance_and_due_date
business_rules.description: Each invoice shows unpaid, partially paid or paid status from its recorded payments, and is additionally marked overdue when an unpaid balance remains after its due date evaluated in Asia/Kolkata calendar days.
triggers: Seller opens a customer's detail page
A payment is recorded or removed
The Asia/Kolkata calendar date passes an invoice's due date
side_effects: The invoice row shows its status label and days overdue where applicable
Overdue invoices are shown separately from invoices not yet due on the customer's page
error_handling: If the due date is missing, the invoice is not marked overdue and is flagged for the seller to complete it
If the balance is zero, the invoice is shown as paid even when past its due date

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: payments_labelled_as_seller_recorded_not_bank_verified
business_rules.description: Every payment in a customer's payment history is labelled as seller-recorded and not bank-verified, and shows its amount, date and method.
triggers: Seller opens a customer's detail page and views payment history
side_effects: Each payment entry in the history displays a seller-recorded, not bank-verified label
Payment history is ordered by payment date, newest first
error_handling: If a payment has no method recorded, it is shown as method not recorded rather than hidden

missing: Payment.payment_date — no column payment_date on payments

business_rules.name: customer_view_respects_private_seller_data_only
business_rules.description: Only the seller can open a customer's detail page and see its invoices, payments and balance, and the public judge demo shows fictional customers only.
triggers: Any request to open a customer detail page
side_effects: Customer data and its payment history are returned only to the authenticated seller
The demo environment displays only fictional customer records
error_handling: If the customer does not belong to the signed-in seller's shop, the page shows a not-found message and no balance details
If the session has expired, the seller is asked to sign in again before any customer data loads

business_rules.name: customer_detail_states_cover_loading_empty_and_error
business_rules.description: The customer detail page shows a loading state while invoices and payments load, an empty state when the customer has no invoices or payments, and an error state with retry when data cannot be loaded.
triggers: Seller navigates to a customer detail page
Invoice or payment data fails to load
side_effects: Seller sees a clear message explaining that the customer has no invoices yet, with a path to create one
On a load failure, the seller can retry without losing navigation
error_handling: Partial failure loading payments still shows invoices with a notice that payment history could not be loaded
Balance is not displayed as zero when data failed to load, to avoid misleading the seller

steps.description: Seller edits the customer's phone or email and saves.

business_rules.name: customer_contact_details_are_optional
business_rules.description: A customer may be saved with a phone number, an email address, both, or neither, and clearing either field on edit is allowed.
triggers: Seller clears the phone or email field on the customer detail page and saves
side_effects: Customer.phone or Customer.email is stored as empty
The customer remains in the customers list with their existing invoices and balance unchanged
error_handling: If both phone and email are blank, the save succeeds and the customer is kept, since the PRD makes both optional
If the save fails to persist, the previous contact values are kept and the seller sees an error message

business_rules.name: whatsapp_draft_available_only_with_phone
business_rules.description: The WhatsApp draft option is offered for a customer only when Customer.phone holds a valid number; otherwise the seller can only copy the reminder.
triggers: Seller saves an edit that adds, changes or removes the customer's phone number
Seller opens a reminder for one of the customer's invoices
side_effects: Future reminder screens for this customer show the WhatsApp draft option when a phone number is saved and hide it when the phone is removed
No message is sent automatically; the seller still reviews and sends any WhatsApp draft themselves
error_handling: If the phone is blank, the WhatsApp draft option is hidden and the copy-reminder option remains available
If the phone fails format validation, the save is blocked and the stored phone is not changed

business_rules.name: contact_edit_does_not_change_financial_records
business_rules.description: Editing a customer's phone or email changes only the Customer record and never alters existing invoices, payments, follow-ups or reminder drafts.
triggers: Seller saves an edited phone or email on the customer detail page
side_effects: Invoice totals, payment amounts and outstanding balances stay the same
Previously recorded follow-ups keep their original sent date and are not marked as resent
Alerts linked to the customer's overdue invoices are not resolved or changed by the contact edit
error_handling: If a related invoice or payment cannot be read during save, the contact update is not applied and the seller sees an error message
If the edit touches no fields, the save completes without writing any records

validation_rules.description: Phone is optional, and when entered it must be a 10-digit Indian mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9, optionally prefixed with +91 or 0 and with spaces or hyphens ignored.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number, for example 98765 43210, or leave it blank.

validation_rules.description: Email is optional, and when entered it must follow a standard address format with an @ symbol, a domain and no spaces, up to 254 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com, or leave it blank.
